You turn raw footage, UGC, and briefs into scroll-stopping short-form video for Meta, TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts - both paid ads and organic posts. Formats: UGC, hooks, problem/solution, testimonial, product-focus, VSL-style, and fresh angle/hook variations of what's already winning. Roughly 1 in 4 videos will use AI generation to extend or reimagine winning angles.



THIS IS NOT THE ROLE IF...

...you log on and wait to be told every cut, send three "just checking?" messages, and need every concept handed to you. It's also not weddings, corporate, or long-form YouTube.



THIS IS THE ROLE IF...

- You understand the algorithm and viewer psychology - why people stop, watch, and buy - and can say WHY an edit works, not just make it look nice.

- You bring your own concepts: you watch what's hitting on our socials and competitors', and pitch new ideas and hooks without being asked.

- You take ownership - you read the brief once, look at our last few winning videos, and ship something that belongs next to them, right the first time more often than not.

- You're resourceful: you find footage, music, and solutions yourself instead of getting stuck.

- Strong on pacing, captions, sound design, and light motion graphics.



NICE TO HAVE

- AI video tools (Higgsfield, Kling, Veo, Runway, ElevenLabs) - a real plus, about 25% of our work.

- Track record on performance / direct-response ads for a DTC / ecommerce brand.

- Sports, fitness, rehab, or anatomy / movement content experience.



HOW WE WORK

No micromanaging - do great work and you get freedom and a clear path to grow into a creative lead / strategist. Base salary + uncapped performance bonuses tied to what your videos deliver. Full-time, remote, long-term, with some daily overlap with EU (Amsterdam) hours.



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

Apply here: 
 - the short form takes about 5 minutes. It asks for:

1. An explainer video (MOST IMPORTANT): a short clip of YOU - on camera or voiceover - walking through one of your own edits: what you did and WHY. We hire on how you think and communicate, not just how you cut.

2. Two or three of your best short-form ads or social videos (links).

3. A brand you admire on social - why their videos work (hook, psychology, retention).

4. One video concept you'd make for a water-filled training product, and the hook you'd open with.

5. The monthly pay you're looking for (your asking rate) and the AI tools you use.



Make every video link viewable - if it's a Google Drive link, set sharing to "Anyone with the link", or we can't open it.



Shortlisted candidates get a small paid test edit before we hire. We review every application through the form above, so please apply there rather than only messaging here.

title: Business Development Associate
description:
What you own



You generate new business from zero. No inbound lead, no existing relationship, no warm intro required — you find who should be working with us, reach them by call, email, or DM, and pitch them on it. You own the entire arc from first contact to signed engagement.



This is not chasing something already agreed to. That's a different seat. You're creating the "yes" in the first place, with people who don't know we exist yet and have no reason to reply to you.



Once something's signed, it's handed off to get built and delivered. Your job ends at the close, not before it, and not indefinitely after it — you're not managing the relationship forever, you're the reason it started.



What disqualifies you

-A generic pitch that doesn't change based on who you're actually talking to

-Overpromising to close — misrepresenting what we actually do isn't a sales technique here, it's a liability we'll have to clean up

-Going quiet after a rejection instead of adjusting and trying the next one

-Needing leads handed to you. If you're waiting to be given someone to call, that's not this role

-Losing track of what's actually been said to whom — sloppy pipeline tracking creates problems for everyone downstream of you



What you need

-A real track record of generating net-new business through outbound — cold calls, cold email, cold DMs, not warm referrals dressed up as cold outreach

-Genuine comfort with rejection and repetition, without needing each attempt to land to keep going

-Sharp enough listening to actually customize a pitch in real time, not just recite one

-No specific degree or credential required



How we hire for this



Not a narrative interview. Talking about how you'd handle a cold call and actually running one are two different skills, so we test the second one directly.



Application: a few standard questions on how you approach outreach, rejection, and follow-up. Not scored as truth — it's the baseline we check your live performance against.



Live round: you'll actually pitch — a real (simulated) cold call or cold outreach scenario, run live. You'll get real objections, real pushback, and direct correction on your approach at least twice in the same session. We're not scoring a polished first pitch. 

We're scoring whether your second attempt is sharper than your first, and whether you can take a note on your approach without getting defensive about it.



If you can start something from nothing and make it land, apply.

title: Operations Program Manager / Chief of Staff
description:
Engineering Studio 



What you own



You're handed a defined goal — already scoped, already d
. From there it's yours: build the plan, identify who needs to move, get them moving, track whether it's actually happening, escalate the 
nt it stalls. You're accountable for outcomes on programs that don't belong to any single team.



You also keep the operating rhythm of the studio intact. That means running the meeting cadence, following up on the commitments people actually made, and making sure decisions get implemented — not just discussed and quietly dropped. When a decision gets made, you make sure everyone affected understands what it means for them, specifically, and actually does it. Catching agreement that wasn't real internalization — before it turns into silent non-alignment — is core to this job, not a side task.



You'll have real, appropriate authority in your scope. Not proximity dressed up as influence, not soft power you have to negotiate for every time. Real authority, held accountable.



You are not shaping strategy — that stays upstream. You are the reason strategy turns into something real, and the reason nothing falls through the cracks between the decisions made and the people executing them.



What disqualifies you



Needing to be managed, reminded, or chased. We manage work, not people.

Explaining intent when corrected instead of fixing. If the correction was clear, "why" isn't needed — only the adjustment.

Agreeing in the room, then not actually internalizing or executing the decision.



What you need



A track record of owning outcomes across teams that don't report to you

Real systems thinking — you see how the pieces connect, not just the next checklist item

Comfortable being the one who says the uncomfortable, accurate thing when a decision isn't actually landing

The ability to take a live correction and produce a clean fix, fast, without it becoming a conversation about you

No specific degree or credential required.



How we hire for this



Not a narrative interview. We've found what people say about handling correction and what they actually do under real, live correction are two different tests — so we run the second one.



Application: a few standard questions about how you approach structure, correction, ambiguity. Not scored as truth. It's a baseline we compare against what we see live.



Live round: real (anonymized) program material, worked through in real time, with direct correction delivered at least twice in the same session. We're not scoring whether your first answer is right. We're watching the gap between the correction landing and the fix starting — and whether that gap shrinks the second time.



If you can take a clear correction and move without needing it softened, apply.

title: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor – Travel & Lifestyle
description:
READ BEFORE APPLYING — DIRECT LONG-FORM VIDEO LINKS ARE REQUIRED



We are established travel and lifestyle content creators with nearly 1 million combined subscribers and followers across multiple platforms. We are hiring a full-time long-form YouTube editor for our creator-led travel, RV, van-life, outdoor, and adventure channel.



Our finished videos are generally 20–45 minutes long. We need an experienced editor who can turn several hours of raw footage into a compelling, story-driven YouTube video—not simply arrange clips in chronological order.



This position is focused on long-form YouTube content, not Shorts, Reels, podcasts, gaming videos, or corporate content.



ABOUT THE EDITING STYLE



A strong style reference for this position is Trent the Traveler.



Before applying, watch several of his long-form YouTube videos and become familiar with his storytelling, pacing, dialogue editing, music selection, sound design, scenic sequences, humor, and emotional timing.



We need an editor who can:



• Find the strongest story within several hours of raw footage

• Create compelling openings that immediately build curiosity

• Structure each video with a clear beginning, middle, and end

• Edit natural conversations without making them feel rushed

• Remove repetitive, unnecessary, or weak footage

• Use music, sound effects, B-roll, and scenic footage effectively

• Build anticipation and maintain viewer interest

• Know when an edit should move quickly and when a 
nt should breathe

• Turn everyday travel experiences into entertaining long-form stories



ENGLISH FLUENCY IS REQUIRED



You must be highly fluent in spoken and written English.



Our videos include natural conversations, humor, sarcasm, reactions, emotional 
nts, and storylines that develop throughout the footage. You must understand the dialogue, tone, and context well enough to make strong decisions about pacing, cuts, music, and emotional timing.



THE ROLE



You will edit complete 20–45 minute YouTube videos from raw footage through final delivery.



You must be able to:



• Review several hours of raw footage and identify the strongest story

• Create a compelling opening and clear beginning, middle, and end

• Edit natural dialogue while preserving humor, emotion, and pacing

• Remove repetitive, unnecessary, or weak footage

• Use music, sound design, B-roll, scenic footage, and travel montages effectively

• Clean and mix audio and perform basic color correction

• Add text, maps, captions, and graphics when needed

• Follow editing notes, complete revisions accurately, and apply feedback consistently

• Meet deadlines, work independently, and communicate clearly

• Send a brief end-of-day email summarizing your progress and any questions



You must have proven experience editing long-form, creator-led travel, lifestyle, RV, van-life, outdoor, or adventure YouTube videos.



You must also have strong storytelling instincts, excellent attention to detail, reliable high-speed internet, a dependable editing computer, and availability for approximately 40 hours per week.



HOW TO APPLY

I READ THE LONG-FORM VIDEO LINK REQUIREMENTS



Then include the following:

• Full name

• Email address

• Current city and country

• Editing software and computer you use

• Expected hourly rate

• Weekly availability

• Normal working hours in Philippine Time

• Earliest available start date

• Whether you currently have another full-time job or major ongoing clients



2. YOUR TOP THREE LONG-FORM VIDEO EDITS



Provide EXACTLY THREE direct, clickable links to individual, published YouTube videos that you personally edited.



All three videos must:



• Be at least 15 minutes long

• Be creator-led travel, lifestyle, RV, van-life, outdoor, or adventure videos

• Link directly to the actual published video

• Clearly demonstrate your long-form storytelling and editing ability



At least one must be a travel, RV, or van-life vlog with storytelling, pacing, and production quality similar to Trent the Traveler’s long-form videos.



For each video, include:



• The direct YouTube link

• The channel name

• The video runtime

• Whether you edited the entire video

• What you personally edited if anyone else was involved



DO NOT SEND:



• Portfolio websites

• Demo reels

• YouTube channel homepages

• Playlists

• Google Drive or Dropbox folders

• Short-form videos

• Links that require us to search for your work



We will only review the three direct video links you submit.



Applications without exactly three qualifying direct video links will not be reviewed.



3. RELEVANT EXPERIENCE



In one short paragraph, describe your experience editing long-form travel, lifestyle, RV, van-life, outdoor, or adventure YouTube videos.



4. EDITING PROCESS



In one short paragraph, explain how you turn several hours of raw travel footage into one compelling 20–45 minute YouTube story.



5. INTERNET SPEED



Provide your Speedtest.net results:

• Upload speed

Include a screenshot or public result link.

COMPENSATION AND HOURS

Analyze the customer's claim, order history, tracking, fulfillment, and communication

Verify live carrier tracking and delivery information

Collect and organize all relevant evidence

Build clear timelines showing order → shipment → delivery → customer communication

Write professional, factual, and convincing PayPal responses

title: AI Static Ads Operator
description:
Type: Full time · Remote · Monday to Friday

Salary: $300 – $400 USD/month depending on speed and consistency, plus a bonus every time one of your statics becomes a winner we scale.



How to apply — read this first



Do not send a message here. Do not send a CV here.



Go to this link and complete the application:







Pick this role from the list. There is a field inside to upload your CV and link your portfolio — that is where we want them. Applications sent any other way are ignored.



What the job is



We run e-commerce brands and we advertise on
 every single day. Winning ads are not invented, they are rebuilt. Our system is already built and documented. We need one person to run it, every day, with Claude.



Your target is 50 finished static ads per day. That number sounds high until you see the process — you are not designing from a blank page. You are taking an ad that already works and rebuilding it for our product.



Your daily work



1. Find what is already winning. Open the ad libraries, find the ads that have been running for months. A long-running ad is a profitable ad. Save them to our swipe library.



2. Rebuild them for our products. Write the image prompt in Claude, generate the image. Same composition, same framing, same energy as the original — only the product, the text and the numbers change. You are not being creative. You are being accurate.



3. Regenerate until it matches. The first output is never right. You look at what is off, you fix the prompt, you go again.



4. Always 1080 × 1080. Every single one, even when the original ad is vertical. You check the exported size before you deliver. This is not open to interpretation.



5. Send the batch every day. You get revision notes back. You apply them the same day and resend. This loop is the job.



6. Log every image — unique name, archived, with the prompt that made it. We must be able to relaunch any winner months later without regenerating it.



What we need from you

Written English that a native speaker would not flag. You write the prompts and the text that goes on the images. This is the first filter, before anything else.

You have used AI image tools. Claude, ChatGPT, Higgsfield, Midjourney, Nano Banana, Firefly — any of them. You already know the first output is rarely good.

You can match a layout. Canva, Photoshop or Figma — place text cleanly, match a font, export exact dimensions.

You follow a written process exactly. "Always 1080 × 1080" means always.

You are extremely organised. File names, folders, registries. If you cannot find an image from three weeks ago in ten seconds, this is not for you.

You tell us when you are blocked instead of going quiet.

You can handle volume without dropping quality. This is repetitive work. The person who thrives here is the person who likes a rhythm, not the person who needs a new challenge every week.

Nice to have



 Ads Manager. Claude Code. Any direct response marketing background — we will train you on our system.



Before you apply



Some of our brands are in health and women's wellness, including intimacy products. The work is never explicit, but if that topic is not for you, this role is not for you and that is completely fine.



What we offer

A stable, long-term, full-time position.

The system already exists. You are not inventing anything, you are running a machine. Everything is documented.

Direct work with the owner. No middle manager, no meetings.

Paid trial first: one reference ad rebuilt for one of our products, 1080 × 1080, three text variations. Good trials get hired within days.

Paid on time, every time.

title: Subscription Retention Consultant — DTC Supplements
description:
Type: Full time · Remote · Monday to Friday

Salary: $800 – $1,500 USD/month depending on experience, plus a bonus tied to the churn you actually remove.



How to apply — read this first



Do not send a message here. Do not send a CV here.



Go to this link and complete the application:







Pick this role from the list. There is a field inside to upload your CV and link your portfolio — that is where we want them. Applications sent any other way are ignored.



What the job is



We sell supplements on a subscription. We are good at acquiring customers. We are not good at keeping them, and we know it: a large share of our subscribers write in to cancel before their second charge, and we are losing money we already paid to acquire.



That is this job. You own retention. Not the tickets — the numbers behind them. You d
 what we say when someone wants to leave, what we offer, when we offer it, and what we change upstream so they stop wanting to leave in the first place.



We are hiring for judgment, not for tasks. You have done this at a subscription brand before and you know what works because you watched it work.



Your work



1. Find out why they leave, with evidence. Read the cancellation reasons, the support inbox, the refund requests, the chargebacks. Group them. Tell us the three real reasons people churn, ranked by how much money each one costs us. Not opinions — counts.



2. Build the cancellation flow. What we ask, in what order, what we offer against each reason. Pause, skip, change frequency, downsize the order, one-time discount, product swap. You d
 the ladder and where the discount sits in it, because a discount given too early is margin we never get back.



3. Fix the money we lose silently. Failed payments and dunning. Card updates. Retry logic. Most subscription brands lose more subscribers to a declined card than to an actual decision to quit, and nobody notices because nobody complains.



4. Work the first 60 days. The subscriber who cancels before charge two never got the product to work. Onboarding emails, dosage expectations, what to feel and when, proactive check-ins. You write the plan and brief whoever executes it.



5. Win them back. Cancelled subscribers are the cheapest customers we will ever have. Build the sequence that brings a share of them back.



6. Report what you changed and what it did. Churn by cohort, retention curve by month, LTV, save rate on cancellation requests, recovered failed payments. Monthly, in numbers, with what you will do next.



What we need from you

title: Supply Chain & Inventory Manager
description:
Type: Full time · Remote · Monday to Friday

Go to this link and complete the application: 



Pick this role from the list. There is a field inside to upload your CV — that is where we want it. Applications sent any other way are ignored.



What the job is



We run several supplement brands on a subscription model. Our stock sits in three different fulfilment centres, our products are made in China, and our subscribers get charged on a fixed cycle whether or not we have inventory to ship them.



Right now nobody owns that chain. Orders get placed when someone remembers. Stock counts live in different places and do not always agree. We find out we are running low when support starts getting emails.



That is this job. You own inventory from the factory to the customer's door. If we run out of stock, that is on you. If we sit on six months of dead inventory, that is also on you.



Your work



1. Know exactly what we have, everywhere. One stock sheet, updated daily, covering all three fulfilment centres and every SKU. Units on hand, units in transit, units reserved. When the number in the sheet does not match what the warehouse says, you find out why and you fix it.



2. Never let us go out of stock. Work out how fast each SKU sells, how long production and shipping actually take, and set a reorder point for every product. Then place the orders before we hit it. On a subscription business a stockout does not just cost one sale, it cancels a recurring customer.



3. Run the suppliers. Place purchase orders, chase production, confirm quantities and quality before anything ships, track every shipment, and escalate when a date slips. Push on pricing as our volume grows.



4. Run the fulfilment centres. Monitor how fast they ship, catch mis-shipments and damaged deliveries, reconcile their stock reports against ours, and hold them to their numbers.



5. Watch the shipments. Parcels stuck in transit, batches never scanned, customs problems. You spot these before customers complain, and you tell support what to say when they do.



6. Report weekly. Stock position, incoming shipments and dates, cash tied up in inventory, anything at risk in the next 30 days. Short, in numbers.



What we need from you



You have done inventory or supply chain for an e-commerce brand, not just warehouse admin. You have placed real purchase orders with real money behind them.



You are comfortable with numbers. Reorder points, lead times, sell-through rates, units per day. You can build this in a spreadsheet without being walked through it.



You are precise. This job is counting things correctly and noticing when two numbers disagree. There is no room for approximation here.



You chase people. Suppliers go quiet, warehouses do not reply. You follow up until you have an answer, without being asked twice.



Written English good enough to deal with Chinese suppliers and US fulfilment centres by email.



Nice to have



Experience with China sourcing and freight. Supplements, food or anything with expiry dates and batch numbers. Shopify. Experience on a subscription business, where demand is predictable and a stockout is unforgivable.



Before you apply



Some of our brands are in health and women's wellness, including intimacy products. The work is never explicit, but if that topic is not for you, this role is not for you and that is completely fine.



What we offer



A stable, long-term, full-time position.

Real ownership. You d
 what we order and when. No committee.

Direct work with the owner. No middle manager.

Paid on time, every time.

What the job is



We run supplement brands and we advertise on
 every single day. Our best-performing ads are AI-generated video: VSLs built from a script, carried by B-roll we generate ourselves.



We have the scripts. We have the system. We need the person who turns a script into a finished Meta ad, every day, using Higgsfield and Google Flow.



Your work



1. Turn the script into a finished VSL.

You get a written script — hook, problem, mechanism, offer. You produce the video that delivers it: generated scenes, voiceover, cuts, captions, sound. Finished ad, ready to upload.



2. Generate the B-roll that carries each beat.

The script says "most people take three supplements a day" — you produce the shot that shows it. You write the prompts in Higgsfield and Google Flow, you generate, and you keep the look consistent from scene to scene: same lighting, same product, same world.



3. Regenerate until it matches.

The first output is never the one. You see what is off — the hands, the label, the timing, the lighting — you fix the prompt and go again. This is most of the craft.



4. Cut it for Meta.

The first three seconds d
 everything. You feel it when a cut lands one beat too slow. Correct dimensions, correct length, caption style, naming convention — every time, no interpretation.



5. Deliver a batch every day, and apply the notes.

You send the day's videos for review, you get revision notes back, you apply them the same day and resend. This loop is the job.



6. Log everything.

Every video archived with a unique name and the prompts that made it. We must be able to re-cut or rebuild any winner months later without starting from scratch.



What we need from you

You have made AI video before, with Higgsfield or Google Flow. Kling, Veo or Runway also count. You already know the first generation is rarely usable.

You can edit properly. CapCut, Premiere or After Effects — pacing, captions, sound design, clean exports.

You understand what makes an ad hold attention. A VSL is not a montage. It builds.

You follow the format exactly. Dimensions, length, captions, naming. Not open to interpretation.

Written English good enough to work from our scripts and answer our revision notes.

Extremely organised. Files, versions, prompts, archives.

You deliver every single day. This is volume with a rhythm, not one masterpiece a month.

ElevenLabs or any voice cloning. UGC-style ads. Direct response video — VSLs, advertorials.

Allied Health Media (Allied Health Media Limited) is a UK healthcare marketing agency, headquartered in London, founded by Abhay Patel in 2022. It helps private medical consultants grow their practices through AI-driven visibility and patient acquisition — ranking them top-3 on Google Maps and AI search to drive self-pay patient calls. Its core offerings include the 12-month Practice Authority Accelerator program, a website design/build service with ongoing retainer, and the Medical Authority Media Series for video and personal branding, all delivered through an in-house team spanning growth, CS, SEO, production, design, and development.



We are looking for an experienced Medical SEO Content Writer who has a strong medical or healthcare background and can create accurate, engaging, patient-friendly, and SEO-optimised content.

title: Operations Manager
description:
# Operations Manager — Customer Experience & Dispatch



Remote · Full-time · Fixed monthly compensation of $2,000–$3,000 · Minimum 40 hours per week, with additional availability for urgent operational needs



## About Dropcurb



Dropcurb coordinates curbside junk removal and partner donation pickups through independent haulers. We are hiring an experienced operations manager to lead our dispatch team, protect the customer experience, and build reliable processes as we grow.



You will work directly with the founder and own how daily operations perform. You should be comfortable handling a difficult order yourself, teaching someone else how to handle it, and improving the process so the same preventable problem becomes less likely to happen again.



## Commitment and availability



This role requires a minimum of 40 hours per week and flexibility to provide additional support when urgent operational issues need attention. We will agree core working hours, aligned with Dropcurb's operating needs, and escalation coverage before you start.



When a serious issue needs management support, step in, coordinate the right people, and follow it through to a verified resolution. Maintain dependable coverage and accepted handoffs. Retain responsibility for urgent issues until a capable owner accepts them or they are resolved, and improve the process to reduce preventable emergencies.



## What you will own



**Learn and run the operation.** Learn our dispatch workflow, customer journey, service boundaries, quoting approach, and tools. Investigate knowledge gaps and become capable of sound independent decisions within agreed limits.



**Exercise pricing judgment and oversee agent use.** Dispatchers handle routine quotes and hauler payouts with our quoting agent. You handle exceptions, spot-check quality, and train the team. Verify scope, access, capacity, timing, comparable jobs, and costs. Check that the agent received sufficient context and produced a sensible answer. Apply established prices and approval limits.



**Make the daily basics dependable.** Establish and verify coverage for inbound calls, prompt messages, required Craigslist posts, shared
, daily review responses, and publishing founder-prepared social posts. Keep work owned through interruptions, absences, and handoffs.



**Protect the customer experience.** Review open and completed orders for broken promises, excessive waiting, customer chasing, inappropriate late pickups, unexpected changes, and poor recovery. Act when commitments become at risk and investigate bad experiences before a complaint or review.



**Respond to urgent issues.** Recognize refund requests, frustrated customers, hauler problems, payment discrepancies, and safety concerns. Take appropriate immediate action, communicate clearly, and verify resolution. Maintain escalation and handoff coverage beyond your core shift.



**Improve processes at the cause.** Investigate why work is lost or mistakes recur. Establish practical routines, checks, ownership, and escalation. Verify adoption and results. Implement useful fixes with existing tools and make evidence-backed requests for software improvements.



**Build and manage a strong team.** Define performance standards, interview through realistic work scenarios, and verify claimed expertise. Run focused team reviews, teach the reasoning behind decisions, check understanding with a new example, and inspect subsequent work. Coach gaps and make evidence-based staffing recommendations.



**Hire and manage a GBP specialist.** Learn the Google Business Profile workflow sufficiently to scope the work and qualify a proven expert for verification, profile health, optimization, and suspension/support issues. Start with the actual workload, verified expertise, and clear deliverables.



**Use AI effectively.** Apply AI to suitable analysis, service review, coaching, and documentation. Verify conclusions against source records and policy, correct errors, and assess whether the workflow improves speed or quality.



## Experience and abilities we are looking for



- Proven hands-on management of a small team responsible for completing time-sensitive service work. Relevant backgrounds include dispatch, home services, field service, transportation, delivery, and comparable operations.

- Specific examples of processes you personally improved, how you got staff to adopt them, and how you verified the result.

- Strong customer-experience judgment, including recognizing when a completed job still represents a poor experience.

- Practical commercial judgment, clear reasoning with incomplete information, and appropriate escalation.

- An established method for managing commitments, notifications, priorities, and follow-through.

- Experience assessing, training, and managing staff, with clear evidence of your personal responsibility.

- Clear spoken and written English for customer, hauler, and team communication.

- Ability to validate the quoting agent's output and train staff to supply sufficient context. Broader experience using AI for analysis and process improvement is a strong advantage.



Experience building processes in a startup or small growing business is preferred. We value initiative, speed, hands-on ownership, and improvements that continue working across shifts. Previous use of our exact CRM is not required. GBP specialist experience is valuable; the manager must be able to assess and manage the expert doing that work.



## How success will be assessed



We will agree priorities, access, authority, service standards, and a baseline during onboarding. Success means dependable daily coverage, fewer preventable misses, earlier detection of customer and hauler problems, sound quoting decisions, adopted process improvements, and less avoidable founder intervention. Material issues must remain visible and receive appropriate escalation.



## How to apply



Send your resume and brief answers to the following:



1. Describe one recurring operational failure you personally reduced. What was the cause, what did you change, and how did you verify the improvement?

2. Describe a customer-experience problem you caught without waiting for a complaint. What did you do, and what happened?

3. What team and workload did you directly manage? What decisions could you make independently?

4. Describe one AI-assisted workflow you actually use, the result it improves, and how you check its output.



Use specific examples and identify your personal contribution. Anonymize confidential information; approximate figures are acceptable when labeled.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid practical assessment using fictional operating records. It includes prioritization, customer recovery, process design, quoting, hiring judgment, and AI use. Finalists may proceed to reference checks with consent and a paid supervised trial or structured onboarding period, with terms and expectations agreed in advance.

title: AI VIDEO EDITOR — FULL-TIME REMOTE | UP TO $3,000/MONTH
description:
WE’RE HIRING: AI CREATIVE EDITOR



Luma is looking for an experienced AI Creative Producer who can take an idea from concept to finished, performance-ready ad.



This is not a “prompt engineer” role.



We’re looking for someone who understands storytelling, advertising, editing, and AI production — and knows how to turn all four into creative that gets attention and drives results.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



You’ll work closely with our Creative Strategists, editors, designers, and marketers to develop and produce high-performing creative for paid advertising.



You should be confident with:



• Writing and scripting

• Hooks and attention-grabbing concepts

• Direct-response advertising

• Visual storytelling

• Pacing, structure, and retention

• Character and product consistency

• AI video and image generation

• Editing and post-production

• Creating both realistic and stylized AI content

• Taking a concept from rough idea to polished final asset



You may use tools such as Veo, Higgsfield, Kling, Runway, Seedance, Midjourney, ChatGPT, Nano Banana, Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or whatever workflow gets the best result.



We care about the output, not the tool stack.



THE STANDARD



We expect you to be able to create realistic AI content that can pass as real footage — including believable humans, products, environments, and movement.



That means:



• Consistent faces and characters

• Natural-looking hands and movement

• Consistent products across shots

• Realistic environments and lighting

• Strong editing and pacing

• No obvious AI artifacts



You should also be comfortable creating stylized AI work — 3D, animation, surreal concepts, cinematic sequences, transformations, and other AI-first visuals where the visual itself becomes the hook.



Most importantly, you need to understand that good creative is more than good-looking footage.



You need to understand why an ad works.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You’re a strong fit if you:



• Have experience creating ads or performance-focused content

• Can develop concepts, not just execute prompts

• Can write scripts and build strong hooks

• Know how to edit without needing step-by-step instructions

• Understand pacing, retention, and direct response

• Can troubleshoot AI generations and find solutions independently

• Have strong creative judgment

• Move quickly without sacrificing quality

• Take ownership of your work

• Are constantly looking for ways to improve the creative



DO NOT APPLY IF



• Your portfolio is mostly raw AI generations

• You only know how to prompt

• You need detailed instructions for every edit

• You don't understand advertising or direct response

• You're looking for a low-pressure role where you can coast



This is not a beginner AI role.



WHAT YOU GET



• $1,500–$3,000/month base, depending on experience and performance on the paid test

• Performance bonuses

• Full-time remote role

• Real creatives running on serious ad spend

• Exposure to actual performance data

• Collaboration with Creative Strategists, editors, designers, and marketers

• Freedom to experiment with new tools and workflows

• Fast feedback loops

• Opportunity to take on more ownership as Luma's AI creative capabilities expand



HIRING PROCESS



Application → Portfolio Review → Paid Test → Interview Call → Paid One-Week Trial → Offer



The qualification test is paid whether or not we move forward.



We care more about what you can actually produce than how well you interview.



HOW TO APPLY



Complete the application form:







Your portfolio matters more than your résumé.



If you can turn an idea into creative that makes people stop, watch, and take action, we want to see your work.

title: Dispute Manager – Shopify & PayPal
description:
# Job Opening: Dispute Manager – Shopify & PayPal



**Position:** Dispute Manager & Supply Chain Coordinator

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Salary:** $3 per hour

**Work Arrangement:** Remote



## About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Dispute Manager with a strong background in Shopify and PayPal dispute resolution, chargeback management, and ecommerce operations. The ideal candidate should be capable of handling payment disputes, minimizing financial losses, and maintaining accurate transaction records.



In addition to dispute management, this role will involve working closely with our supply chain operations, including monitoring incoming and outgoing products, reviewing supplier quotations, verifying pricing, and coordinating order fulfillment.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Dispute & Chargeback Management



* Handle Shopify Payments disputes, PayPal disputes, chargebacks, and payment-related customer complaints.

* Prepare and submit compelling evidence and documentation within the required deadlines.

* Monitor dispute cases, track outcomes, and maintain detailed records.

* Investigate fraudulent transactions, unauthorized payments, and item-not-received claims.

* Identify recurring dispute patterns and recommend ways to reduce chargebacks and financial losses.

* Coordinate with customer support and fulfillment teams to resolve disputes effectively.



### 2. Supply Chain Management



* Monitor products coming into and going out of the business.

* Review supplier quotations, invoices, and product costs to verify pricing accuracy.

* Compare supplier prices and identify discrepancies or potential cost-saving opportunities.

* Track order fulfillment, shipping updates, delivery delays, and missing or damaged products.

* Coordinate with suppliers and logistics partners to resolve operational issues.

* Maintain accurate records of inventory movements, supplier transactions, and order statuses.



### 3. Reporting & Operations



* Prepare regular reports on dispute rates, chargeback outcomes, and financial exposure.

* Maintain organized documentation for disputes, suppliers, and order-related issues.

* Work alongside the management team to improve payment operations and supply chain efficiency.



## Required Qualifications & Experience



* **Proven professional experience** managing disputes and chargebacks for Shopify and PayPal.

* Practical experience preparing and submitting dispute evidence through Shopify and PayPal platforms.

* Strong understanding of ecommerce payment processes, refunds, chargebacks, and fraud-related claims.

* Previous experience in supply chain management, supplier coordination, order fulfillment, or inventory operations.

* Experience reviewing supplier quotations, invoices, and product pricing.

* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

* Good written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple responsibilities.



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience working with Shopify stores that process a high volume of orders.

* Familiarity with payment dispute prevention tools and ecommerce fraud indicators.

* Experience using spreadsheets, inventory management systems, and order tracking tools.

* Ability to prepare clear operational reports and identify process improvements.



## Compensation



**Base salary: $3 per hour.**



Performance-based salary reviews and potential increases may be considered based on demonstrated results, reliability, and overall contribution to the business.



## How to Apply



Please submit your application with the following information:



1. Your relevant experience managing Shopify and PayPal disputes.

2. Examples of dispute and chargeback cases you have handled.

3. Your experience with supply chain management and supplier coordination.

4. The tools and platforms you have previously used.

5. Your availability and expected working hours.



**Important:** Applicants must have practical, hands-on experience in both dispute management and supply chain operations. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of these responsibilities and contribute to the smooth operation of our ecommerce business.

title: Google Business Profile Specialist — Setup, Verification & Management
description:
We’re hiring an experienced Google Business Profile specialist to own profile creation, verification, optimization, and ongoing management across our local markets. You’ll also work directly with interested people, guiding them through the setup and verification process and following through until each next step is completed.



You must have direct, hands-on experience creating and verifying profiles, managing multiple listings, and handling suspensions and reinstatement appeals. We need someone who can bring their expertise, identify problems, and move work forward independently.



You will be responsible for:

- Profile creation and verification: Assess location eligibility, set up accurate profiles, configure categories, services, hours, contact information, and booking links, and manage verification through completion.



- Hauler outreach and coordination: Contact interested haulers, explain the process clearly, collect necessary information, schedule walkthroughs, and guide them through verification requirements, including video verification when required.



- Suspensions and reinstatements: Investigate the issue, identify and correct underlying problems, gather legitimate supporting documentation, submit appeals, and manage follow-ups with Google.



- Ongoing optimization: Keep profiles complete and accurate, improve relevant categories and services, maintain photos and posts, and identify opportunities to improve local visibility and customer conversion.



- Review management: Monitor and respond to reviews in a professional, natural voice. Flag customer concerns to the appropriate team and follow through on unresolved issues.



- Profile monitoring: Check for verification problems, unexpected edits, duplicate listings, inaccurate information, and other issues that could affect visibility or customer trust.



- Performance reporting: Track profile visibility, website clicks, calls, and attributable bookings where tracking is available. Explain what changed, what you believe caused it, and what action you recommend.



- Organization and follow-through: Maintain a clear tracker for every profile and hauler, including current status, open issues, last contact, next action, and follow-up date.



To be considered, you must have:

- Personally created and verified Google Business Profiles, including service-area businesses and location-based businesses.

- Direct experience handling suspensions and reinstatement appeals, with examples of your work and outcomes.

- Experience managing multiple profiles at the same time.

- A working understanding of Google’s current business representation guidelines and suspension appeal process.

- Strong written and spoken English, with the confidence to guide haulers over calls, messages

- The ability to troubleshoot independently, recognize when an issue needs escalation, and follow up without repeated reminders.



- Availability for 40 hours per week, including scheduled calls with U.S.-based haulers.

Experience with U.S. home services, local SEO, citation audits, and managing profiles across multiple markets is a plus.

Success in this role means accurate, verified profiles; haulers who understand and complete their next steps; timely review responses; well-managed suspension cases; and measurable progress toward qualified inquiries and bookings.

To apply, please include:

1. A brief summary of your GBP experience, including how many profiles you have personally created, verified, and managed.

2. One example of a location-verified profile you helped verify. Explain your role, the challenge, and the outcome.

3. One suspension or reinstatement case you personally handled. Explain what happened, what you did, and the result.

4. Supporting screenshots, case studies, or references where available. You may redact private client information.

5. Your time zone, availability, and confirmation that 40 hours per week at $800 USD per month works for you.

Please be specific about the work you personally completed and the results you can substantiate.

You should be comfortable investigating technical documentation and working with APIs you have not used before.



---



# Automation Platforms



Strong experience with one or more of the following is important:



* 

* Zapier

* n8n

* Google Workspace automation

* Google Apps Script

* API-based automation



We do not want to use no-code tools simply because they are easy.



Sometimes Make or Zapier will be the right solution.



Sometimes an API, script or custom application will be better.



We want someone capable of making that distinction.



---



# Keap / Infusionsoft



**Keap / Infusionsoft experience is highly desirable.**



A significant part of our CRM and marketing infrastructure connects with Keap.



Useful experience includes:



* Contacts

* Tags

* Custom fields

* Campaigns

* Opportunities

* Orders

* Forms

* Segmentation

* Reporting

* Keap API

* Webhooks

* External integrations



Strong Keap experience will be viewed very favourably.



However, an exceptional developer who can quickly learn Keap should still apply.



---



# Reporting & Data



We want to significantly improve our reporting and reduce manual reporting work.



Projects may involve data from:



*
 / Meta advertising

* Google advertising

* Keap

* Webinar platforms

* Calendly

* Sales systems

* Membership systems

* Websites

*
 campaigns



Useful experience could include:



* Looker Studio

* Power BI

* Metabase

* Google Sheets

* Airtable

* Databases

* SQL

* ETL / data pipelines

* Automated management reporting



We want dashboards and reports that are useful for decision-making — not dashboards that simply look impressive.



---



# AI Content Automation



We also have large amounts of video, webinar and written content.



We want to build systems that can automatically turn source content into multiple outputs while maintaining quality and brand consistency.



Examples include:



* Articles

*
s

* Social posts

* Summaries

* Short-form videos

* Scripts

* Educational content

* Lead magnets

* Knowledge-base content



Experience with tools such as:



* HeyGen

* Higgsfield

* AI image generation

* AI video generation

* AI voice

* Avatars

* Automated editing

* Content publishing workflows



is useful but **not essential**.



These are bonus skills rather than requirements.



---



# Data Security & Privacy



You may eventually work with customer information, CRM data, internal company documents, advertising accounts and client systems.



Security therefore matters.



You should understand good practices around:



* Least-privilege access

* API key management

* Secrets management

* Password security

* OAuth

* Development vs production environments

* Data privacy

* Backups

* Rollback

* Logging

* Monitoring

* Access revocation

* Sensitive customer information

* Appropriate use of data with AI models

* Testing before production deployment



If you normally share passwords in chat or upload sensitive customer databases to random AI tools without considering privacy, this role will not be a good fit.



---



# How We Think About Automation



We do not simply want someone who waits for us to say:



> “Build this Zap.”



We want someone who can look at a process and ask:



**Why are we doing this manually at all?**



Then determine:



* What can be deleted?

* What can be automated?

* What should AI handle?

* What should remain human?

* Where should human approval be required?

* What data should be captured?

* How should errors be detected?

* What happens if the automation fails?

* Can the system be reused elsewhere?

* Can we make the system simpler?



We prefer **simple, reliable systems** over unnecessarily complicated ones.



---



# Documentation Is Important



We do not want critical systems that only one person understands.



Where appropriate, systems should include:



* Clear naming conventions

* Documentation

* Git/version control

* Workflow diagrams

* Loom walkthroughs

* Test cases

* Error handling

* Monitoring

* Change logs

* Troubleshooting instructions

* Backup/rollback procedures



A good system should be maintainable by someone other than the original developer.



---



# Who We Are Looking For



You are likely a strong fit if you:



* Have genuine software development ability

* Are highly interested in AI

* Actively experiment with new AI tools

* Think in systems

* Are an excellent problem solver

* Can work independently

* Understand business outcomes

* Can explain technical concepts simply

* Are careful with production systems

* Are comfortable researching unfamiliar APIs

* Can challenge our ideas when there is a better solution

* Like automating yourself out of repetitive work

* Are proactive rather than purely reactive

* Want to build systems rather than just complete tickets



We are **not** looking for someone who agrees with every request.



We value people who can say:



> “There is a better way to build this. Here is what I recommend and why.”



---



# Long-Term Opportunity



This role will begin part-time at approximately:



**10–20 hours per week**



However, we have a significant backlog of AI, development and automation projects.



For someone who consistently produces high-quality work, hours and responsibility can increase significantly.



Longer term, we want to build an AI / automation capability that supports multiple businesses and client projects.



There may eventually be opportunities to:



* Work on larger client projects

* Build reusable automation products

* Help architect AI systems

* Supervise junior developers or automation specialists

* Help recruit additional technical team members

* Become a technical lead within our AI / automation team



We are looking for someone we can work with for **years**, not simply someone to build one automation.



---



# Hours & Working Style



Approximately:



**10–20 hours/week initially**



We care more about output, reliability and quality than tracking every minute.



Because we are based in Australia, some overlap with Sydney business hours is useful, but full Australian working hours are not required.



Please tell us your normal working hours and availability.



---



# Compensation



**US$12–20/hour depending on experience and demonstrated ability.**



We are willing to pay toward the top of this range — and potentially beyond it — for an exceptional person with strong development, AI, automation and systems experience.



We will likely begin with a **small paid technical project** before providing significant access to production systems.



---



# How to Apply



Please start your application with:



**AGENTIC BUILDER**



Then answer the following questions.



### 1. Best Project



Tell us about the most technically impressive AI or automation system you have personally built.



What problem did it solve?



What did you personally build?



### 2. Technical Mix



Approximately what percentage of your experience would you describe as:



* Development/code

* Automation/no-code

* AI/agents



### 3. AI Development Tools



Which of the following do you use regularly?



* Claude Code

* Codex

* Other AI development tools



Explain briefly how you use them.



### 4. AI Agents



Have you built autonomous or semi-autonomous AI agents?



What did they actually do?



### 5. Agentic Technologies



Have you worked with:



* MCP

* Agent memory

* Multi-agent architectures

* Agentic OS-style systems



Please explain briefly.



### 6. Development



What experience do you have with:



* Python

* JavaScript

* TypeScript

* APIs

* Databases

* Git/GitHub



### 7. Automation



What experience do you have with:



* 

* Zapier

* n8n



Which do you prefer and why?



### 8. Keap / Infusionsoft



Have you worked with Keap or Infusionsoft?



If yes, please explain exactly what you have built or managed.



### 9. APIs



What APIs have you integrated?



Please give specific examples.



### 10. Reporting



What reporting dashboards or data pipelines have you built?



Which tools did you use?



### 11. Data Security



How do you normally handle:



* Passwords

* API keys

* Secrets

### 12. Content Automation



Have you built AI content-generation or content-repurposing workflows?



Please describe one.



### 13. Portfolio



Please send any relevant:



* GitHub links

* Screenshots

* Case studies

### 14. Rate



What is your hourly rate in USD?



### 15. Availability



How many hours per week are you available?

### 16. Current AI Interests



What are you currently learning, testing or experimenting with in AI that you believe will become important over the next 12 months?



Please keep your application concise.



We would much rather see **evidence of what you have actually built** than a long generic proposal.



**Please do not send a generic AI-generated application.**



We are looking for a strong technical builder who wants to help us create something substantial over the long term.

title: Short-Form Video Editor – UGC, TikTok & Instagram Reels | Fast Turnaround | High Volume
description:
I’m looking for a **reliable, hardworking short-form video editor** who can work with me long-term and handle a **high volume of videos with fast turnaround times.**



### PAY

**$5 USD per completed video — fixed rate.**



This position is $5 per completed video, no more and no less. Please only apply if you are comfortable with this rate.



There is an opportunity for a **large amount of consistent work** for the right editor. I create a lot of content and am looking for someone I can regularly send videos to.



### WHAT YOU’LL BE EDITING

You should be comfortable editing:



- Short-form UGC content

- TikTok videos

- Instagram Reels

- Creator/personal brand content

- Fitness and lifestyle content

- Talking-head videos

- Raw footage that needs to be turned into polished short-form content

- Trend-style videos that may require recreating the pacing/style of a reference video

- Captions, text overlays, music, sound effects, transitions, B-roll, and other elements when appropriate



I need someone who understands **modern short-form content** and can make videos feel fast-paced, engaging, and native to TikTok and Instagram rather than overly edited or outdated.



### TURNAROUND TIME

**12 hours or less is expected for most videos.**



Fast communication and turnaround are extremely important to me. I need someone who checks messages regularly and can get to work quickly when footage is sent.



### WHAT I’M LOOKING FOR

I want someone who is:



- Hardworking and motivated

- Reliable and consistent

- Able to handle **high volume**

- Able to follow detailed instructions

- Creative enough to use their own judgment when something could be improved

- Familiar with current TikTok/Reels editing styles

- Detail-oriented

- Easy to communicate with

- Interested in consistent, long-term work

- Able to meet deadlines without needing to be constantly reminded



I will provide instructions and references when necessary, but I also want you to use your own creative judgment. If you think a different clip, transition, cut, or editing decision would make the video better, I want you to be able to recognize that.



### TEST EDITS

Before being hired, you will be asked to complete **1–2 test edits.**



**The test edits are unpaid unless I d
 the finished edit is good enough that I want to use it. If I want to use your test edit, I will pay you the normal $5 rate for that video.**



Put real effort into the test. If you create something strong enough for me to actually post and use, you will be paid for it.



The test edits are also an opportunity for me to see your editing quality, communication, ability to follow instructions, and turnaround time.



### LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY

I’m not looking for someone to edit only a few videos. I’m looking for an editor who can become part of my regular workflow.



**If you are fast, reliable, produce high-quality work, and can handle volume, I can provide you with a lot of ongoing work.**



If this sounds like you, please apply with examples of your **best short-form TikTok, Instagram Reel, or UGC edits** and tell me how quickly you can normally complete a short-form video.

GoHighLevel Experience Required

QuickBooks Online

Stripe or Square

Time Doctor

Financial services, credit services or business funding

How to Apply



Use the subject line: GHL PAYROLL COORDINATOR



Please include:



A brief introduction and your résumé.

title: Creative Operations Manager (AI Video & Static Ads)
description:
Type: Full time · Remote · Monday to Friday

Salary: $500 – $700 USD/month depending on experience, plus a bonus on every month the pipeline ships without a miss.



How to apply — read this first



Do not send a message here. Do not send a CV here.



Go to this link and complete the application:







Pick this role from the list. There is a field inside to upload your CV and link your portfolio — that is where we want them. Applications sent any other way are ignored.



What the job is



We run e-commerce brands and we advertise on
 every single day. We have editors producing AI video ads and designers producing AI static ads. They make things. Nobody makes sure those things are good, on time, and live.



That is this job. You are the person the whole pipeline runs through — from assigning the work in the morning to the ad being live in the account the same day.



The work itself is not complicated. What matters is that it happens every day, on time, with nothing missed.



Your work



1. Run the team's day.

Assign the work to the video editors and the static designers. Follow it through the day. Chase what is late before it becomes a problem, not after.



2. Quality check every single creative.

Nothing goes anywhere without passing our checklist first. Wrong dimensions, cut-off text, wrong logo placement, wrong price — you catch it here, because after this there is only us and the customer.



3. Send back real revision notes.

When a creative fails, the editor gets exactly what is wrong and exactly what to change. Not "make it better". "The price badge is cut off on the right, move it 40px left and re-export at 1080 × 1080." Then you re-check the revised version.



4. Get the approved ads live.

Upload and launch in
 Ads Manager, following our naming and setup rules. Every day, five days a week. New ads go live daily, no exceptions.



5. Keep the system honest.

At the end of each day you know what shipped, what is still open, and what is blocked. Nothing lives only in your head.



What we need from you

Extremely reliable. This is the whole job. If you are late or you skip days, stop reading — this role is not for you.

Detail-oriented. You notice something is off in a creative before it goes live, not after. We will test this in the application.

Written English good enough to instruct editors. You write revision notes all day. They have to be understood the first time.

Comfortable holding people to a deadline. These are not your employees. You still have to make the work land.

Comfortable with Slack, Google Sheets and Google Docs.

You use AI tools in your daily work — ChatGPT, Claude.

Nice to have


 Ads Manager experience is a real plus, but we will train you on our exact process. Any background in creative production, agency operations or quality control.



Before you apply



Some of our brands are in health and women's wellness, including intimacy products. The work is never explicit, but if that topic is not for you, this role is not for you and that is completely fine.



What we offer

A stable, long-term, full-time position.

A documented system. You are not inventing anything, you are running a machine that already works.

Direct work with the owner. No middle manager, no meetings for the sake of meetings.

Paid trial first: we send you three real creatives and our checklist. You tell us which ones fail, why, and you write the revision notes you would send the editor. Good trials get hired within days.

Paid on time, every time.



Again: the only way to apply is

title: Meta Media Buyer - Restricted E-Commerce
description:
READ THIS FULLY BEFORE APPLYING. There are specific application instructions at the bottom. Applications that ignore them are deleted unread. This is deliberate, and it is the first test.



ABOUT US



We're a North American based performance marketing agency. We run Meta advertising for e-commerce brands in restricted and regulated categories: canna and CBD accessories, nicotine, spirits, and research peptides. These are underserved brands in acute pain, and we get them live and spending fast.



We are small, direct, and we do not micromanage. What we need is people who close their own loops.



WHAT THIS ROLE ACTUALLY IS



This is not a role where you inherit warm accounts and tune creative. Roughly half this job is keeping ad accounts alive, and the other half is getting campaigns live before they die. If that sounds unappealing, stop reading. You will be unhappy here.



Day to day: sourcing and warming profiles, BMs and ad accounts; billing and verification; building and publishing campaigns across multiple accounts and brands; appeals and reinstatement; and reporting status in writing without being asked.



YOU MUST HAVE



- Hands-on Meta buying experience in restricted, grey or high-risk verticals. Mainstream dropshipping or local lead gen alone is not enough.

- YOUR OWN ACCOUNT SUPPLY CHAIN, or a clear and specific process for building one. This is the single most important requirement. If your answer is "I use whatever the client gives me," you are not a fit.

- Real experience with appeals, business verification, and what actually gets accounts reinstated versus what wastes a week.

- Pixel and Conversions API setup, BM structure, and enough technical comfort to debug tracking yourself.

- Written English strong enough to explain a problem clearly the first time.



HOURS



Monday to Friday, 6:00 AM to 3:00 PM Philippine time. Fixed.



We deliberately do not want anyone working past midnight their own time. Outside those hours you are off, with one narrow exception for a disabled account or runaway spend.



PAY



7 to 10 USD per hour depending on demonstrated experience, paid twice monthly. Starts with a paid two-week trial on one client, at full rate. Performance review at 60 days.



HOW TO APPLY



Send a message with the subject line: APEX - [Your Name] - Account Supply



In the body, answer these five. Short and specific beats long and polished:



1. Where does your ad account, BM and profile supply come from? Describe the actual process, not the outcome.

2. It is the morning after a ban wave and four accounts are down. What are your first three actions, in order?

3. Send Ad Library links to accounts you are running right now.

4. What is the longest you have kept an account alive in a restricted vertical, and what finally killed it?

5. Tell us about a time you had to tell a client something would not be done on time. What did you say?



Do not send a generic portfolio.

title: Performance Video Editor for Meta Ads – Long Term
description:
Hey, we’re Atmos, a small family-run business in New Zealand making handmade guitar straps.



We’re looking for an experienced video editor to work with us long term, starting at around 20 hours per week.



Most of the work will be creating ads for
 and Instagram. We have plenty of content for you to work with, including UGC from different creators, professional lifestyle and product footage, workshop footage, customer reviews and content from our team.



We’re looking for someone who has experience editing Meta ads for ecommerce brands and understands the strategy behind a good ad, not just the technical side of editing.



I don’t want to have to plan every cut or tell you exactly how to make each ad. I want someone who can look through our footage, understand the angle we’re trying to communicate and come up with their own ideas for turning it into an effective ad.



What we're looking for



You should have a good understanding of:



- Meta/Facebook and Instagram advertising

- Direct-response ecommerce ads

- Creating strong hooks, especially in the opening few seconds

- UGC-style advertising

- Pacing and keeping attention

- Using captions and on-screen text effectively

- Product and offer positioning

- Social proof and customer review ads

- Calls to action

- Testing different hooks, angles and ad structures

- Taking a winning ad and creating new variations of it

- Understanding basic ad performance metrics such as CPA, CTR and ROAS

- Using performance results to help d
 what creative to make next



You’ll be creating things like UGC ads, product-focused ads, gift ads, customer review ads, brand/handmade ads and new variations of creatives that are already performing well.



We care more about quality and performance than simply producing as many videos as possible, but we will be producing a good volume of new creative every week.



I also want the finished ads to feel real and authentic. Please don’t use obviously AI-generated images, video, voices or other elements in the ads. Using AI tools behind the scenes to help with your workflow is completely fine, but the finished ads shouldn’t look or sound AI-generated.



Pay and hours:



US$12–18/hour depending on experience



Starting at approximately 20 hours per week.



This is a long-term position, with the opportunity for more hours and increased pay if things go well.



I’d like to find someone who can learn our brand, understand what works with our customers and eventually become our go-to editor.



It’s completely fine if you have other clients or work. I just need someone who can reliably commit to the agreed workload and turn work around consistently.



Paid test:



Before hiring, I’ll choose a small number of applicants to complete a paid editing test.



You’ll be given the same raw footage and a basic brief. I want to see how you approach the ad yourself, including the hook, footage selection, structure, pacing and overall concept.



I’m interested in your creative judgement and understanding of advertising, not just your technical editing ability.



To apply



Please send:



- 3–5 of the best Meta ads you’ve edited for ecommerce brands

- Your hourly rate

- A little about your experience creating paid social ads

- Any experience you have using ad performance data to guide your editing or creative decisions

- What editing software you use

- Your usual turnaround time

- What other ongoing work or clients you currently have



Please send actual ecommerce ads rather than a general editing showreel.



You can have a look at Atmos here:







Thanks,

Alex

title: Live Shopping Host / Online Sales Host
description:
We are hiring confident, energetic Live Shopping Hosts to present and sell e-commerce products during live online shopping shows for a U.S. audience.



You will NOT need to show your face on the livestream. During your shift, you will share your screen and display still images of products while speaking to viewers. Your voice, spoken English, personality, energy, and ability to sell are the most important parts of this role.



IMPORTANT — WHATSAPP REQUIRED:

You must include an active phone number connected to WhatsApp in your application. We will contact applicants through WhatsApp regarding the next stage of the hiring process. Please double-check that your country code and phone number are correct.



What you’ll do

Host live online shopping shows using screen sharing

Display still images of mugs and tumblers during auctions

Introduce and describe new product designs

Speak naturally and enthusiastically with a U.S. audience

Read and respond to live viewer comments

Encourage bidding and participation without sounding overly pushy

Keep the show entertaining and moving at a good pace

Follow product queues and simple pricing/show guidelines

Receive real-time coaching and feedback from our team

Help us identify which designs and presentation styles perform best



What the livestream looks like



You will not appear on camera and you will not physically hold the products.



Viewers will see product images on screen while you host the livestream using your voice.



Think of the role as a combination of a radio host, livestream presenter, and salesperson.



Who we’re looking for

Excellent spoken English is a must

Very easy for American customers to understand

Natural, warm and conversational speaking style

Confident speaking continuously for long periods

Strong personality and energy

Able to improvise instead of simply reading a script

Quick at reacting to comments and questions

Comfortable selling and encouraging customers to bid

Coachable and comfortable receiving live feedback

Reliable high-speed internet

Quiet working environment

Able to work an 8-hour shift

Active WhatsApp account and phone number required



Sales, livestreaming, customer service, call-center, radio, podcasting, or hosting experience is helpful, but voice quality, English fluency, personality, and sales instinct are more important than previous experience.



Interview process



The majority of our hiring process is asynchronous, so you will not need to attend multiple live interviews.



Applicants who move forward will be contacted through WhatsApp.



The selection process will include:



Short voice-recording test — we want to hear your English fluency, pronunciation, tone and personality.

Product presentation video test — you will receive product images and record yourself presenting/selling them as if you were hosting a live shopping show.

Longer mock-hosting test for selected candidates to evaluate improvisation, energy and consistency.

Final live video interview with our team.



You do not need professional recording equipment. A smartphone or computer with clear audio is sufficient.



Compensation



$4–$6 USD/hour depending on experience + 5% commission on the sales revenue you personally generate during your shifts.



Strong hosts can therefore earn substantially more than the base hourly rate based on their sales performance.



High performers may also receive:



additional shifts

increased base pay

greater responsibilities

long-term opportunities as the operation grows



Hours: Approximately 40 hours/week, generally in 8-hour shifts.



When applying, remember to include your WhatsApp phone number with country code.

title: California Personal Injury Case Manager
description:
We are hiring an experienced Personal Injury Case Manager to help manage California pre-litigation cases from intake through settlement.



This is not a basic administrative VA position.



We are looking for someone who understands how a personal injury case actually moves, can independently manage the operational side of a case, and knows when an issue needs to be escalated to an attorney.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



You will help manage the full lifecycle of pre-litigation personal injury cases, including:



Case opening and client onboarding

Liability investigation

Police reports and Traffic Collision Reports

Insurance and policy-limit investigations

BI, UM/UIM, MedPay, and property damage claims

Client communication and regular case updates

Medical treatment tracking

Medical records and billing follow-up

Tracking specialists, imaging, injections, surgeries, and future treatment recommendations

Identifying treatment gaps and missing documentation

Health insurance, Medi-Cal, Medicare, and lien tracking

Wage-loss and damages documentation

Monitoring statutes, deadlines, and demand timelines

Preparing cases for demand

Reviewing files for missing records, bills, evidence, or coverage

Tracking settlement offers and negotiations

Settlement and lien-resolution support

Maintaining accurate and organized CRM records

What We’re Looking For



We want someone who can look at a case and immediately ask:



What is the liability situation?

What insurance coverage is available?

Are there additional policies or defendants?

Is there UM/UIM or MedPay?

Are there multiple claimants?

Is the client's treatment progressing appropriately?

Are records and bills complete?

Are there liens or reimbursement issues?

What evidence are we still missing?

Is the case demand-ready?

Is there a deadline or issue the attorney needs to know about?



You should be able to manage a file proactively instead of waiting for instructions for every task.



Required Experience



You should have prior experience working with a U.S. personal injury law firm, preferably handling California cases.



Strong candidates will already understand concepts such as:



Pre-litigation personal injury workflow

Bodily Injury insurance

UM/UIM

MedPay

Per-person and per-a
 policy limits

Policy-limits demands

Liability investigation

Medical records and billing

Treatment timelines

Medical liens

Demand preparation

Settlement documentation

Statute and deadline tracking



You do not need to give legal or medical advice. Legal strategy, settlement authority, and medical decisions remain with attorneys and licensed healthcare providers.



What we need is someone who knows how to identify issues, organize the evidence, keep the case moving, and escalate matters appropriately.



The Type of Person Who Will Succeed Here



You are:



Extremely organized

Detail-oriented

Proactive

Comfortable handling multiple active cases

Strong in written and spoken English

Confident communicating with clients, insurance adjusters, medical providers, and attorneys

Able to work independently

Comfortable being held accountable for deadlines and case progress

Someone who investigates instead of assuming

Someone who documents everything



We value people who can tell an attorney:



“Here are the verified facts, here is what we are missing, here is the deadline, and here is what needs your decision.”



Schedule



This is a full-time remote position working primarily during California business hours.



Applicants must have:



Reliable computer

Stable high-speed internet

Quiet professional workspace

Reliable backup internet or contingency plan



How to Apply

Please send the following:



Your resume

A vocaroo recording that tackes the following:

A description of your personal injury experience

How many PI cases you have managed at one time

Which states you have handled PI cases in

Your experience with BI, UM/UIM, MedPay, demands, medical records, and liens

The case management or CRM systems you have used

Your expected monthly compensation



We are looking for someone who does more than complete tasks.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of a case, understand what is happening, anticipate what is missing, and help move it toward resolution.
