Managing and checking our Meta setups daily

Setting up and preparing new
 Pages

Connecting Pages to the correct Business Managers and advertising assets

Connecting and managing pixels

Connecting ad accounts and other required assets

Preparing replacement/new setups when necessary

Keeping profiles, Pages, Business Managers and ad accounts properly organized

Checking that everything is connected correctly before campaigns are launched

Troubleshooting setup and asset connection issues

Maintaining a clear overview of all our Meta assets



Previous experience with this type of Meta setup management is required.



Media Buying Responsibilities



You will also support our media buying operations.



This includes:



Launching new Meta campaigns

Launching Cost Cap campaigns

Warming up new ad accounts

Setting up campaigns according to our internal structure

Performing daily checks

Supporting the team with campaign launches and other Meta-related tasks

We can teach you our campaign structures, Cost Cap strategy and launching processes.



What is much more important is that you already understand Meta Business Managers, Pages, profiles, ad accounts, pixels and asset connections.



Who We're Looking For



You should be:



Extremely organized

Detail-oriented

Accurate and careful with your work

Comfortable managing many Meta assets at the same time

Experienced with Meta Business Manager and advertising infrastructure

Able to follow SOPs and instructions precisely

Reliable with daily recurring tasks

Interested in growing into a full-time position



Small mistakes in this role can create large problems, so attention to detail is extremely important.



Hours & Growth



You will initially work approximately 4 hours per day, 6 days per week.



If things go well, we expect this position to grow into a full-time role within approximately 2 months.



Starting compensation is $5 USD per hour.



There will be opportunities to take on more responsibility as the company continues to grow.



How to Apply



Please do not send us a generic application.



In your application, we specifically want to know about your experience with Meta setups and infrastructure.



Please explain:



Your experience managing Meta Business Managers

Approximately how many Business Managers, ad accounts, Pages and profiles you have managed before

Your experience connecting Pages, pixels, ad accounts and other assets

Your experience creating and preparing new Meta setups

Your experience dealing with restricted or disabled Pages, Business Managers or ad accounts

Your experience warming up new ad accounts

Your experience with launching Meta campaigns and Cost Caps

Any other relevant Meta infrastructure experience you have



The setup/infrastructure experience is the most important part of your application.



Campaign launching can be taught. Being organized and already understanding how to properly manage Meta infrastructure cannot.



If you have strong Meta setup experience, excellent attention to detail, and want to grow with a large e-commerce operation, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Appointment Setter - Onyx (GoHighLevel CRM)
description:
Compensation: $3.00/hour + Commission

Schedule: Full Time / Remote

Industry: Life & Mortgage Protection Insurance



Position Overview



We are looking for a reliable, motivated, and detail-oriented Appointment Setter / Virtual Assistant to join our mortgage protection insurance team. This position is responsible for communicating with prospective clients, following up with leads, answering inbound calls, making outbound calls, and scheduling qualified, quality appointments for licensed agents.



The ideal candidate is comfortable communicating with clients through phone calls and text messages, understands the importance of timely follow-up, and can confidently maintain conversations without making the interaction feel overly scripted or sales-focused.



This is a performance-based position. We are looking for someone who is consistent, organized, proactive, coachable, and interested in building a long-term working relationship with the team.



Key Responsibilities



Lead Follow-Up & Communication



Respond to new leads and client inquiries in a timely and professional manner.

Send text messages to leads and maintain consistent follow-up until the lead responds, schedules, or is appropriately dispositioned.

Communicate naturally and professionally rather than relying solely on copy-and-paste responses.

Answer questions within the scope of the position and recognize when a lead should be transferred or escalated to a licensed agent.

Maintain a professional, friendly, and confident tone with prospective clients.



Inbound & Outbound Calling



Answer inbound calls from prospective clients and existing leads.

Make necessary outbound calls to leads who have not responded to texts or require additional follow-up.

Make follow-up calls to previously contacted leads and missed appointments when necessary.

Confirm appointments and help reduce no-shows through proper communication and reminders.

Communicate clearly with prospects while maintaining professionalism throughout every interaction.



Appointment Setting



Schedule appointments based on the agent's availability and established scheduling procedures.

Focus on setting quality appointments, not simply filling the calendar with unqualified prospects.

Confirm that the prospect understands the reason for the appointment and is available to speak with the licensed agent.

Collect and verify necessary information before scheduling when applicable.

Follow up with prospects who miss, cancel, or need to reschedule appointments.

Maintain a strong appointment-to-contact and appointment-to-show mindset.

CRM Responsibilities



The Appointment Setter will be expected to become comfortable using CRM systems, including Onyx and GoHighLevel (HighLevel).



Responsibilities include:



Entering and updating lead information accurately.

Properly dispositioning every lead after calls, texts, and follow-ups.

Updating lead statuses based on the outcome of each interaction.

Recording important notes so the agent has sufficient context before speaking with the prospect.

Maintaining organized follow-up pipelines.

Setting reminders and tasks when additional follow-up is required.

Monitoring scheduled appointments and ensuring leads receive appropriate confirmation messages.

Keeping the CRM clean, accurate, and up to date throughout the workday.

Learning and following the team's specific CRM processes and workflows.



CRM accuracy is extremely important. Leads should never be left without a disposition, note, or appropriate next step when one is required.



The ideal candidate should be:



Highly reliable and consistent

Comfortable speaking with people over the phone

A strong written communicator

Comfortable texting prospective clients professionally

Able to respond quickly to new leads and inbound inquiries

Organized and detail-oriented

Comfortable learning and navigating Onyx and GoHighLevel

Able to multitask between calls, texts, CRM updates, and appointment scheduling

Coachable and willing to learn the team's processes

Proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do

Comfortable handling basic objections and keeping conversations moving

Able to recognize when a prospect is genuinely interested versus simply giving a low-quality appointment

Capable of working independently while remaining accountable to performance expectations

Quality Over Quantity



Our goal is not simply to schedule as many appointments as possible. Appointment quality matters.



Successful candidates will be expected to:



Consistently follow up with assigned leads.

Respond to new inquiries within a reasonable timeframe.

Maintain accurate CRM records.

Complete required inbound and outbound calls.

Keep up with assigned texting and follow-up responsibilities.

Maintain organized appointment calendars.

Minimize avoidable no-shows through proper confirmations and reminders.

Meet established activity and appointment-setting expectations.

Take initiative when additional follow-up is needed.

Communicate promptly with management regarding questions, issues, or lead concerns.

title: Demand & Supply Planner – End-to-End Planning & MRP
description:
Who We Are



Starbond is a growing adhesive company committed to excellence, customer centricity, curiosity, humility, and continuous improvement. We sell through Amazon, Shopify, and B2B channels and are strengthening our supply chain planning capabilities to support reliable product availability and scalable growth.



The Role



Starbond is seeking a highly analytical and proactive Demand & Supply Planner with at least five years of hands-on experience across the complete planning cycle: demand forecasting, supply planning, inventory optimization, material requirements planning (MRP), and production planning.



This role owns planning from end to end. You will develop a reliable consensus demand forecast, convert it into inventory and material requirements, and create executable purchasing, production, and distribution plans. You will monitor actual performance, identify changes and risks, and continuously revise the plan based on new information.



This is not a role for someone who has only maintained an existing planning system. The successful candidate must also be able to build, audit, and improve an Excel-based planning and MRP tool from the ground up. You will connect channel forecasts, bills of materials, inventory, open purchase orders, supplier lead times, capacity, and production requirements into one dependable planning process.



The ideal candidate combines strong technical planning knowledge with excellent judgment, emotional intelligence, ownership, and proactive communication. You should be comfortable identifying weak assumptions, explaining risks clearly, and recommending practical improvements rather than waiting for detailed instructions.



Key Responsibilities



Demand Planning and Forecast Ownership

Own the SKU- and channel-level demand forecast across Amazon, Shopify, and B2B.

Develop rolling forecasts using sales history, seasonality, promotions, customer commitments, product life cycles, channel plans, market intelligence, and future business assumptions.

Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and leadership to gather forecast inputs, challenge assumptions, resolve differences, and establish a documented consensus demand plan.

Separate baseline demand from promotional, event-driven, new-product, and one-time demand.

Track forecast accuracy and bias by SKU and channel, investigate material variances, and improve forecasting methods over time.

Maintain documented forecast assumptions, risks, opportunities, scenarios, and version history.

Identify demand changes early and clearly communicate their expected impact on inventory, purchasing, production, capacity, and cash flow.



Supply and Inventory Planning

Translate the approved demand forecast into time-phased inventory, purchasing, production, and distribution requirements.

Establish and maintain SKU-level reorder points, safety stock, order quantities, and inventory targets.

Apply appropriate safety-stock methods using desired service levels, demand variability, lead-time variability, and supplier reliability.

Monitor stockout risks, excess inventory, slow-moving products, inventory turnover, forecast accuracy, and service levels.

Create constrained and unconstrained supply plans and identify where supplier, material, capacity, cash, or storage limitations prevent the business from meeting demand.

Recommend prioritized actions that balance customer service, inventory investment, operating cost, and business risk.



MRP and Excel Tool Development

Build, maintain, audit, and improve an Excel-based MRP and replenishment system.

Integrate core planning data, including the SKU master, sales forecast, stock on hand, open purchase orders, supplier lead times, bills of materials, and purchasing recommendations.

Create reliable formulas, data-validation controls, exception flags, dashboards, and scenario models that make the tool accurate, understandable, and easy to maintain.

Identify broken links, duplicated data, manual work, weak assumptions, and opportunities for automation.

Document planning logic, data sources, ownership, update frequency, and standard operating procedures.



BOM, Materials, and Production Planning

Perform BOM explosion by converting finished-goods demand into component, packaging, and raw-material requirements.

Account for existing component inventory, open orders, lead times, minimum order quantities, yields, scrap, and production constraints.

Translate material availability and demand requirements into practical production schedules.

Identify material shortages, capacity conflicts, and timing risks early and recommend feasible solutions.

Coordinate with Procurement, Operations, suppliers, and warehouse partners to align purchase and production plans.



Supply Planning and Risk Management

Evaluate supplier performance, including actual versus quoted lead times, delivery reliability, quality issues, and supply variability.

Recommend safety-stock adjustments, order timing, secondary sourcing, or other mitigation measures based on quantified risk.

Develop supply scenarios for demand changes, supplier delays, promotions, new-product launches, and capacity limitations.

Ensure planning recommendations balance product availability, working capital, storage constraints, and operational cost.



S&OP, Reporting, and Cross-Functional Communication

Provide concise planning updates that clearly identify risks, business impact, recommended actions, responsible owners, and deadlines.

Lead or support a structured monthly S&OP planning cycle connecting demand, supply, inventory, capacity, and financial considerations.

Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Procurement, Operations, and leadership to reconcile forecasts with supply capabilities and business priorities.

Present S&OP scenarios, gaps, tradeoffs, assumptions, and recommendations to decision-makers.

Document agreed decisions and ensure changes flow into the demand forecast, supply plan, purchasing plan, and production schedule.

Communicate proactively when information is incomplete, assumptions change, or a plan is at risk.



Required Qualifications



At least five years of hands-on experience covering both demand planning and supply planning, including inventory, materials, or production planning.

Demonstrated ownership of a rolling SKU-level forecast and the ability to translate it into an executable supply plan.

Strong understanding of forecasting methods, seasonality, promotions, forecast accuracy, forecast bias, consensus planning, and scenario analysis.

Demonstrated experience building or substantially redesigning an MRP, inventory-planning, or replenishment tool in Excel.

Strong knowledge of reorder-point logic, safety-stock modeling, lead-time variability, service levels, and inventory optimization.

Practical experience with BOM explosion and raw-material or component planning.

Advanced Excel skills, including structured tables, XLOOKUP or INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, PivotTables, conditional logic, data validation, error controls, and scenario modeling.

Experience translating forecasts into purchase and production requirements.

Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions constructively.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong ownership, emotional intelligence, attention to detail, and proactive communication.

Availability to work a full-time schedule aligned with Pacific Time.

title: Procurement Specialist (experience with US and Asian suppliers required)

We are looking for a Procurement Specialist who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys building supplier relationships, negotiating favorable commercial terms, solving supply chain challenges, and continuously improving procurement operations. This role is ideal for someone who is analytical, proactive, highly organized, and comfortable working with suppliers across multiple countries and cultures.







Position Summary

The Procurement Specialist is responsible for sourcing and managing suppliers across the United States and Asia, negotiating pricing and commercial terms, evaluating supplier capabilities, and ensuring a reliable and cost-effective supply of materials.



This role plays a critical part in protecting supply continuity, reducing procurement costs, supporting contract manufacturing initiatives, and ensuring Starbond maintains a diversified supplier network that supports long-term business growth.



Key Responsibilities



Strategic Sourcing

Source, evaluate, and qualify suppliers across the United States and Asia.

Conduct supplier research, RFQs, quotation comparisons, and supplier evaluations.

Develop and maintain qualified primary and backup suppliers for critical materials.

Identify new sourcing opportunities that improve cost, quality, and supply continuity.

Support contract manufacturer and third-party logistics (3PL) sourcing initiatives.

Verify supplier capabilities, certifications, and compliance requirements.



Supplier Relationship Management

Build and maintain strong professional relationships with suppliers.

Monitor supplier responsiveness, lead times, pricing, and overall performance.

Conduct supplier performance reviews and maintain supplier scorecards.

Coordinate corrective actions when supplier performance issues arise.

Work closely with suppliers to resolve procurement challenges and minimize operational disruptions.



Cost Optimization

Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and commercial agreements.

Analyze supplier quotations and landed costs.

Benchmark supplier pricing and market conditions.

Identify cost-saving opportunities while maintaining quality and supply reliability.

Recommend sourcing strategies that improve overall profitability.



Procurement Operations

Maintain accurate supplier records and procurement databases.

Support purchase order creation and supplier follow-ups.

Keep supplier pricing, lead times, MOQs, and procurement data up to date.

Organize procurement documentation and sourcing records.

Ensure procurement information is accurate, complete, and audit-ready.



Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Prepare procurement reports and sourcing updates.

Maintain procurement dashboards and tracking tools.

Identify opportunities to improve procurement processes and documentation.

Support continuous improvement initiatives across procurement and supply chain operations.

Proactively identify supply risks and recommend mitigation strategies.





Qualifications



Required

Minimum 3 years of experience in procurement, sourcing, purchasing, or supply chain.

Hands-on experience working with both U.S. and Asian suppliers (China, Taiwan, Vietnam, India, or other APAC countries).

Proven experience sourcing, qualifying, and negotiating with international suppliers.

Strong negotiation and relationship management skills.

Excellent analytical and cost analysis abilities.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Excellent organizational skills with strong attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.



Preferred

Experience working with contract manufacturers or OEM/ODM suppliers.

Experience supporting manufacturing, industrial products, chemicals, or eCommerce businesses.

Familiarity with ERP, MRP, or procurement management systems.

Experience analyzing supplier performance metrics and procurement KPIs.





What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is someone who:

Takes ownership and follows through without constant supervision.

Builds strong supplier relationships while negotiating effectively.

Thinks strategically and solves problems proactively.

Communicates clearly and escalates risks early.

Makes data-driven decisions rather than assumptions.

Continuously looks for opportunities to improve procurement processes.

Is highly organized and detail-oriented.

Can comfortably work with suppliers across different countries, cultures, and time zones.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
About Starbond

Starbond is a growing direct-to-consumer brand focused on delivering high-quality products and an excellent customer experience. We are looking for a hands-on Marketing Manager who can turn data, customer insights, and strong execution into profitable growth.



About the Role

The Marketing Manager will own Starbond’s direct-to-consumer growth engine across paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, content, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), social media, conversion optimization, and agency performance. This role requires a strong command of unit economics—including customer lifetime value (LTV), customer acquisition cost (CAC), CAC payback period, gross margin, and contribution margin—and the ability to convert these metrics into sound growth decisions.



You will directly manage marketing agencies across Meta, Google, email, and AEO while leading the internal Marketing team, setting clear performance standards, and giving the CEO timely visibility into results, risks, and recommended actions.



Key Responsibilities



DTC Growth and Customer Acquisition

Develop and lead the DTC acquisition strategy across Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, email, SEO, social media, Amazon alignment, and other relevant channels.

Manage marketing for profitable growth—not revenue or ROAS alone—by incorporating product margin, contribution margin, retention, and customer quality into decisions.

Establish acceptable CAC thresholds by product, customer segment, campaign, and channel, and recommend when to scale, restructure, reduce, or discontinue investment.

Align advertising, creative, landing pages, offers, product positioning, inventory availability, and operational readiness.



LTV, Retention, and Lifecycle Marketing

Maintain a clear and consistent LTV methodology using customer revenue, purchase frequency, retention, gross margin or contribution margin, and cohort data.

Analyze LTV and retention by acquisition source, product, cohort, and customer segment, and use the findings to improve channel and offer decisions.

Lead strategies that improve repeat purchase rate, purchase frequency, average order value, cross-sell, replenishment, retention, and win-back performance.

Oversee email and lifecycle marketing quality, segmentation, deliverability, revenue contribution, and customer communication accuracy.



Paid Advertising and Conversion

Oversee paid media strategy, budget pacing, campaign structure, audience strategy, creative testing, attribution, and landing-page performance.

Establish clear testing, scaling, optimization, and stop-loss rules, and require decisions to be supported by sufficient data and financial context.

Review performance at the channel, campaign, audience, creative, product, and cohort levels.

Partner with the Web Developer on Shopify priorities, site performance, conversion rate optimization, tracking, and quality assurance.



Agency and Vendor Management

Directly manage marketing agencies across Meta, Google, email, and AEO, including scopes of work, deliverables, timelines, communication standards, SLAs, KPIs, reporting, ownership, and escalation procedures.

Use agency scorecards and recurring performance reviews to track KPI attainment, SLA compliance, output quality, timeliness, efficiency, and business results.

Require root-cause analysis and time-bound corrective action plans for missed targets, SLA breaches, quality issues, reporting gaps, or inefficient spend.

Independently validate agency recommendations and recommend contract expansion, renegotiation, reduction, replacement, or termination when appropriate.

Ensure Starbond retains access to and ownership of advertising accounts, data, dashboards, creative files, documentation, and intellectual property.



Content, Creative, and Brand

Maintain an active content and creative pipeline supported by clear briefs, owners, deadlines, QA standards, and success metrics.

Ensure reliable content-production support is available when external resources are required.

Create a structured process for testing creative concepts, hooks, formats, messages, offers, and calls to action.

Protect product positioning and perceived value by avoiding excessive reliance on discounting and ensuring marketing claims are accurate and supportable.

Ensure approved assets are properly named, organized, and stored in company-owned systems.



Team Leadership, Process, and Reporting

Lead the internal Marketing team by setting clear responsibilities, deadlines, quality standards, KPIs, communication expectations, and individual performance targets.

Conduct regular coaching, one-on-ones, performance reviews, and accountability conversations; identify skill gaps and coordinate development or corrective action with HR.

Make timely recommendations regarding training, role clarity, workload changes, reassignment, or other performance actions when standards are not met.

Create and maintain marketing processes, approval flows, reporting definitions, campaign documentation, and quality-control systems.

Maintain a weekly marketing scorecard that distinguishes leading and lagging indicators and explains what changed, why it changed, and what action is required.

Proactively escalate material risks and present concise, financially grounded recommendations to the CEO.



What Success Looks Like



Marketing data, forecasts, campaign reports, creative briefs, and recommendations are accurate, validated, and financially grounded.

Campaigns, agency deliverables, reports, corrective actions, and launches are completed on time, with blockers escalated early.

CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, MER, ROAS, contribution margin, retention, and cohort performance are consistently defined and used to guide decisions.

Marketing investment produces profitable customer growth, stronger retention, faster learning, higher-quality execution, and stronger brand protection.

The Marketing team and external agencies operate with clear ownership, measurable standards, and consistent accountability.

Proven experience leading DTC or e-commerce marketing across paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, content, and conversion optimization.

Strong working knowledge of CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, MER, ROAS, contribution margin, retention, cohort analysis, and marketing attribution.

Experience managing Meta Ads, Google Ads, email marketing, SEO, AEO, Shopify, and agency partners.

Experience leading and developing marketing team members, setting KPIs, and managing performance.

Excellent written and verbal communication, with a proactive and concise reporting style.

Highly organized, accountable, and comfortable working in a remote, fast-moving environment.



Tools and Platforms

Google Workspace, ClickUp, Shopify, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Amazon advertising and marketplace reports, Google Analytics, Looker Studio or Power BI, Klaviyo or a similar lifecycle platform, spreadsheets, and agency reporting systems.



How to Apply

Describe a DTC or e-commerce business you helped grow and the results you personally influenced.

Share an example of how you used CAC, LTV, contribution margin, retention, or cohort data to make a marketing decision.

Describe your experience managing marketing agencies and holding them accountable to KPIs and deadlines.

List the advertising, analytics, e-commerce, and lifecycle marketing platforms you have used.

This remote position requires a dynamic individual with a strong background in supply chain management, particularly within the eCommerce sector, who is eager to contribute to our fast-growing organization.



Key Responsibilities



Supply Chain Management: Oversee end-to-end eCommerce supply chain operations, ensuring smooth procurement to customer delivery.



Outsourced Manufacturing: Manage and coordinate outsourced manufacturing operations, ensuring alignment with company standards, quality, and timelines.



Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with internal teams (Purchasing, Marketing and Sales) and external partners (suppliers, freight forwarders) for resource optimization and profitability.



Performance Measurement: Identify reporting needs and deliver concise, accurate reports. Lead the team in implementing best practices and measuring performance using KPIs.



Data Reporting: Prepare clear, informative business reports for colleagues and management.



Warehouse & Logistics Expertise: Act as a subject matter expert, aiding in KPI compliance across warehouse functions.



Continuous Improvement: Drive process enhancements, accuracy improvements, and supply chain efficiency through the development, maintenance and upkeep of SOPs.



Quality Assurance: Ensure products meet customer expectations upon leaving the warehouse.



Technology Oversight: Implement and Manage eCommerce supply chain (MRP, ERP, WMS, KATANA and EDI) tech and fulfilment network.



Cost-Efficient Distribution: Optimize distribution and freight practices.



Inventory Management: Monitor and optimize inventory levels.



Cost Studies: Lead cost reduction studies and seek ongoing improvement opportunities.



Professional Growth: Stay updated on industry trends and best practices.





Qualifications (Mandatory)



eCommerce Supply Chain Experience: 4+ years of experience.



Education: Bachelor's degree in Business or Transportation & Logistics.



Warehouse Knowledge: Strong understanding of warehouse processes.



Certification: Certified Six Sigma Black Belt or higher.



Interpersonal Skills: Excellent collaboration skills with cross-functional teams.



Project Leadership: Demonstrated project leadership and issue resolution.



Communication Skills: Strong written, verbal, and presentation abilities.



Problem-Solving: Quick and sound judgment in issue resolution.



Adaptability: Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.



Organization & Decision-Making: Exceptional organizational and decision-making skills.



Data Analysis: Proficiency in data analysis tools, including Google Sheets and MS Excel.



Results-Driven: Proactive approach, driven by results, and willing to take ownership of challenges.



Working Hours: Pacific Standard Hours (night shift)

title: Mobile App Developer Needed — Interactive Kids Virtual Pet / Adventure App
description:
PROJECT OVERVIEW:



I am looking for an experienced mobile app developer or small development team to build a highly interactive children's mobile app for iOS and Android.



The app combines:



• A virtual pet companion

• Interactive daily activities

• Voice interaction

• Mini-games

• Rewards and collectible items

• Pet care

• Character progression/evolution

• Fantasy challenges

• Multiple unlockable environments

• Bedtime stories

• Parent dashboard

• AI-powered features



This is NOT a simple educational app with static screens.



The goal is to create something that feels like a polished children's game where the character reacts constantly to what the child does.



The child should be tapping, dragging, speaking, choosing, helping, collecting, exploring and interacting with their character throughout the experience.



I already have extensive concept art, UI references, character ideas, gameplay concepts and screen flows.



The selected developer will receive the deeper product specification after selection and NDA.



--------------------------------------------------



CORE FEATURES



1. CHILD ONBOARDING



The app begins with a polished onboarding experience where the child:



• Enters/selects their name

• Chooses a character/pet

• Meets their companion

• Completes a short interactive introduction

• Enters the main game environment



The onboarding should feel animated and magical rather than like filling out forms.



------------------------------------------
. VIRTUAL PET SYSTEM



The child has their own interactive pet/companion.



The pet should:



• Blink

• Move

• Celebrate

• Sleep

• Eat

• Drink

• Play

• React emotionally

• Respond to activities

• Grow/evolve over time



The pet should feel alive.



Static character images alone will not be enough.



------------------------------------------
. MAIN INTERACTIVE HUB



Instead of a standard menu, children enter a fantasy environment containing different interactive locations.



Examples:



• Pet home

• Activity areas

• Games

• Story area

• Drawing area

• Challenges

• Collectibles

• Locked areas

• Future environments



The child taps different parts of the environment to enter activities.



------------------------------------------
. DAILY ACTIVITIES



The app will include rotating daily tasks and interactive missions.



Tasks can include:



• Helping someone

• Sharing

• Cleaning

• Listening

• Completing a simple challenge

• Speaking certain phrases

• Drawing

• Taking care of their pet



The app should react differently depending on the child's response.



Example:



The character asks the child a question.



The child answers YES or NOT YET.



If NOT YET, the character may encourage them to complete the activity and come back.



------------------------------------------
. VOICE INTERACTION



Several parts of the app require the child to speak.



Eventually the app should support speech recognition so certain words or phrases can be detected.



As words are spoken correctly, they may visually:



• Light up

• Become underlined

• Glow

• Trigger animations

• Advance progress



Experience integrating speech recognition is a major plus.



------------------------------------------
. REWARD SYSTEM



Completing activities earns rewards.



Possible rewards:



• Toys

• Badges

• Stars

• Character XP

• Decorations

• Collectibles

• New animations

• New areas

• Character upgrades



After certain tasks, the child may choose between several rewards.



------------------------------------------
. TOY COLLECTION



The child's pet can collect toys.



The child can:



• Choose toys

• Give toys to the pet

• View the collection

• Watch the pet interact with toys

• Unlock rarer items



Different toys should trigger different animations.



------------------------------------------
. PET HOME



The pet has its own home.



The child can enter it and interact with the pet.



Activities may include:



• Feeding

• Giving water

• Playing

• Cleaning

• Bathing

• Bedtime

• Organizing the room

• Toy collection



This area should feel like a virtual-pet game.



------------------------------------------
. DRAG-AND-DROP MINI-GAMES



Several activities involve direct touch interaction.



Examples:



• Dragging toys to different characters

• Cleaning a room

• Sorting objects

• Moving items to correct locations

• Giving an object to the pet

• Completing simple touch-based puzzles



Strong drag-and-drop UX is important.



------------------------------------------
. CHARACTER CHALLENGES / BATTLES



The app will include fantasy challenge sequences.



These should feel cinematic and game-like.



The child's pet may face larger fantasy characters/creatures.



The child completes voice or interaction challenges to reduce the opponent's power and complete the encounter.



The system should be reusable so many different challenges can be created using one engine.



------------------------------------------
. CHARACTER PROGRESSION



The pet grows and changes visually as the child progresses.



Eventually there may be multiple evolution stages.



Progression can unlock:



• New appearance

• New effects

• New abilities

• New animations

• New areas

• Stronger challenge abilities



------------------------------------------
. MULTIPLE ENVIRONMENTS



The app architecture should support multiple fantasy environments/worlds over time.



Each environment may contain:



• Different artwork

• Activities

• Challenges

• Characters

• Rewards

• Collectibles

• Final challenge

• Unlock progression



Do NOT hard-code every world separately.



The system should be scalable and data-driven.



------------------------------------------
. DRAWING ACTIVITY



The child can participate in creative drawing activities.



Eventually this may support:



• Built-in drawing

• Parent-assisted camera capture

• AI-assisted image recognition

• Positive character feedback



The experience should always be encouraging.



------------------------------------------
. BEDTIME MODE



The app will contain a calmer nighttime experience.



The child can:



• Help put the pet to bed

• Select a story

• Listen to narrated content

• Complete simple breathing exercises

• Watch calming animations



The app will launch with multiple bedtime stories and should allow new stories to be added later without rebuilding the app.



------------------------------------------
. GUIDED CALMING ACTIVITIES



There may be short audio/visual activities such as:



• Breathing exercises

• Relaxation activities

• Simple guided listening experiences



These should feel integrated into the game rather than like a clinical health app.



------------------------------------------
. AI CHARACTER CONVERSATION



A future/premium feature may allow the child to talk to their pet using AI.



The character should:



• Understand simple child speech

• Respond briefly

• Remain age appropriate

• Maintain personality

• Follow strict child-safety rules



This feature will require significant safety and parental-control architecture.



Experience with OpenAI/LLM APIs, moderation and child-safe AI systems is a major plus.



------------------------------------------
. CAMERA-BASED MINI-GAMES



Future versions may include optional camera interaction with parental permission.



For example:



• Smile-based challenges

• Simple facial movement games

• AR-style interactions



This should NOT be designed as medical or psychological emotion detection.



------------------------------------------
. PARENT DASHBOARD



There will be a completely separate parent-only section.



Parents may eventually see:



• Activities completed

• Rewards earned

• Character progress

• Stories listened to

• Badges

• Usage summary

• Child profiles

• Privacy settings

• Camera permissions

• Microphone permissions

• AI settings

• Content settings



The parent area must be protected by a parental gate.



------------------------------------------
. CHILD PRIVACY AND SAFETY



This app is intended for young children.



Child safety and privacy are extremely important.



The developer should understand or be willing to carefully implement:



• COPPA requirements

• Apple Kids Category requirements

• Google Play Families requirements

• Parental consent

• Child-data minimization

• Secure storage

• Camera/microphone permissions

• Safe analytics

• Appropriate parental gates



There will be:



• No public child profiles

• No stranger messaging

• No unrestricted child-to-child chat

• No public ranking of identifiable children



--------------------------------------------------



TECHNICAL DIRECTION



I am open to technical recommendations.



My current preferred direction is:



• React Native

• Expo

• TypeScript

• iOS + Android from one codebase



Potential backend:



• Supabase

or

• Firebase



Future integrations may include:



• Speech recognition

• Text-to-speech

• AI APIs

• Camera/vision

• Audio

• Subscriptions

• Analytics

• Push notifications



Animation experience with any of the following is a major plus:



• Rive

• Lottie

• React Native Reanimated

• Spine

• Similar game-animation technology



--------------------------------------------------



IMPORTANT DEVELOPMENT REQUIREMENT



I do NOT want someone to simply create 100+ completely separate hard-coded screens.



The application needs reusable systems.



For example:



One activity engine should support many activities.



One challenge/battle system should support many different characters.



One story player should support many stories.



One reward system should support many reward types.



One pet-care system should support multiple actions.



The application needs to be scalable because much more content will be added after launch.



--------------------------------------------------



DESIGN STYLE



I already have visual concepts.



The final product should feel:



• Premium

• Magical

• Highly animated

• Colorful

• Warm

• Child friendly

• Game-like

• Modern

• Polished



This should NOT look like a generic business application or basic educational app.



Character animation and visual feedback are extremely important.



--------------------------------------------------



WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



Ideally you have experience with several of the following:



• React Native / Expo

• iOS + Android apps

• Mobile games

• Children's apps

• Interactive animation

• Rive / Lottie

• Drag-and-drop interactions

• Speech recognition

• Audio

• AI APIs

• Camera features

• Backend development

• App Store / Google Play deployment



Experience with virtual pets, children's games or highly interactive mobile products is a major advantage.



--------------------------------------------------



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer ALL of the following:



1. Show me the most interactive mobile app or game you have built.



2. What part of it did YOU personally develop?



3. Have you built anything involving:

   - Virtual pets?

   - Mobile games?

   - Character animation?

   - Speech recognition?

   - AI?

   - Children's apps?



4. What technology stack would you recommend for this project?



5. Can you build both iOS and Android?



6. Are you an individual developer or a team?



7. Can you handle frontend AND backend?



8. What animation technology would you use?



9. How would you structure the app so hundreds of future activities can be added without rebuilding everything?



10. Approximately how long would you expect a strong first playable version to take?



11. What is your expected pricing structure?



12. Are you willing to sign an NDA before receiving the complete product concept and detailed feature documentation?



Please do NOT send only generic websites, WordPress sites or basic admin dashboards.



I am specifically looking for somebody capable of building a polished, interactive mobile experience.



If the initial build goes well, this can become a substantial long-term project with many future features, characters, environments and content updates. - This is one of 8 projects we will be working on.

title: Trailer Management Admin
description:
GH Logistics (AJG Transport) is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup to delivery.



If you’re someone who enjoys structured execution, asset visibility, and maintaining operational accuracy behind the scenes, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You support the Trailer Manager in overseeing a fleet of 1000+ trailers across multiple carriers and terminals. You play a critical role in ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly assigned, compliant, and operational. This is not a passive data-entry role. You’re the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate, coordinates trailer repair concerns, and flags problems before they cost us time and money.



You should be familiar with common trailer repair and maintenance issues and understand how to coordinate practical solutions with drivers, terminals, vendors, and maintenance teams. If you thrive on structure, take pride in clean records, and don’t let things slip through the cracks, this role was built for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor, update, and reconcile trailer locations across the network on a daily basis

• Coordinate with route supervisors, internal team, dispatchers, carriers, drivers, and terminals to ensure accurate trailer assignments and timely movement

• Track trailer availability, maintenance schedules, and repair status

• Identify trailer issues, assess their operational impact, and coordinate the appropriate repair solution

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date trailer documentation (registrations, inspections, tags, insurance)

• Support reporting on trailer utilization, downtime, and compliance

• Identify discrepancies, missing updates, or unreported trailer statuses and escalate promptly

• Assist in improving internal trailer tracking systems for better visibility and accuracy

• Execute processes consistently with strong attention to detail

• Collaborate cross-functionally with dispatch, compliance, and maintenance teams



What Success Looks Like

• Trailer locations and statuses are consistently accurate and fully reconciled

• Assignments, availability, and movements are properly documented and updated in real time

• Maintenance, repair, and compliance records are complete and up to date

• Trailer defects and repair needs are identified early, properly communicated, and resolved efficiently

• Discrepancies are identified early and resolved before impacting operations

• Reporting on utilization and downtime is clean, accurate, and actionable

• Communication across departments is clear, timely, and structured



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in fleet management, trailer maintenance coordination, logistics coordination, truck or trailer repairs, dispatch, or similar live operational roles (not general admin work)

• Familiarity with common dry van and refrigerated trailer repairs, defects, and maintenance concerns

• Ability to understand trailer repair issues, determine the appropriate next steps, and coordinate solutions

• Knowledge of common trailer components and issues, such as tires, brakes, lights, doors, landing gear, air lines, electrical systems, refrigeration units, and structural damage, is strongly preferred

• Strong attention to detail with high accuracy in tracking and record-keeping

• Organized and capable of managing multiple data points across systems and teams

• Clear and professional communication skills across departments

• Familiarity with platforms such as Samsara, LoadStop, or similar tracking systems is a plus

• Proactive mindset, able to identify and address issues before they escalate

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Logistics tools

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: Tuesday - Saturday 8 PM - 6 AM CDT

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Zoom presence required (camera on throughout shift)

• Hubstaff time tracking during shifts.



What You'll Get

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Paid biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Direct access to US executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager. You work directly with our operations team.

• Real operations work.



Who Thrives Here

• People who've worked in a US freight brokerage or 3PL and want something more stable

• Former fleet coordinators, logistics admins, or dispatch support staff who are tired of BPO environments

• Fleet admins who take ownership. You don't clock in and zone out. You manage trailers like they are your business.

• People who can recognize trailer issues, coordinate repairs, follow up consistently, and ensure equipment returns to service as quickly as possible

• People who want to grow into leadership but need the right company to do it in.



Who This Isn't For

• General VAs looking for easy remote work. This is real logistics and not admin tasks.

• People who need constant supervision or step by step instructions for every task

• Anyone who can't commit to US shift hours consistently

• Candidates without actual freight/logistics experience. We don't have time to teach the basics.

• Candidates who are unfamiliar with trailer maintenance concerns or are uncomfortable coordinating repairs and operational solutions



This role is built for someone who takes pride in maintaining control over moving assets, ensuring trailers are accounted for, properly assigned, properly repaired, and always operational. If you value structure, accuracy, problem-solving, and keeping operations running clean behind the scenes, you’ll thrive in this role.

/GHApplicationForm

title: Track & Trace Assistant – Quality Assurance

As we continue to scale nationally, we are looking for a Track & Trace Assistant – Quality Assurance to help ensure that every load is verified, compliant, and properly tracked before it moves.

title: Transportation Tracker - OTR Operations
description:
AJG Transport is expanding its route operations division and seeking a reliable, detail-oriented professional to help support and streamline our daily transportation duties. We are looking for a Transportation Tracker to support real time fleet movement, manage load data accuracy, and ensure smooth coordination between drivers, customers, and internal teams.



Role Overview

You will serve as a real time control point within route operations. Your responsibility is to ensure loads are properly assigned, tracked, updated, and documented while maintaining consistent communication across drivers, brokers, and customers. You will operate within structured SOPs while making fast, sound operational decisions when challenges arise.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor lanes, driver movement, load progress, ETAs, and service requirements using GPS and TMS.

• Assign and dispatch loads based on driver availability, Hours of Service, customer requirements, and operational priorities.

• Maintain accurate real-time load data, check calls, timestamps, delivery milestones, and documentation in TMS and Google Sheets.

• Communicate with drivers, brokers, and customers while proactively addressing delays, route conflicts, detention risks, and other service issues.

• Follow established dispatch and escalation SOPs, provide clear shift reports and handoffs, and escalate operational risks to leadership as needed.



What Success Looks Like

• Monitor lanes and critical loads with urgency, accuracy, and consistency from start to finish.

• Maintain complete, accurate, and up-to-date information across TMS, Google Sheets, and tracking platforms.

• Provide scheduled updates on time with clear, concise, and actionable communication.

• Identify and escalate operational risks early, bringing solutions and next steps whenever possible.

title: Transportation Tracker – Local Operations
description:
AJG Transport is expanding its operations team and is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented professional to support our local transportation operations while providing additional OTR support as needed. We are looking for a Transportation Tracker – Local Operations who can monitor day to day driver activity, coordinate local tasks, maintain accurate load visibility, and help ensure local drivers remain productive throughout their shifts. This is a hybrid operations role, as local execution may vary from day to day and additional OTR tracking or operational support may be assigned when local activity is limited.



Role Overview

You will help coordinate the daily movement and activities of our local drivers. Your primary focus is to ensure drivers are continuously moving, scheduled tasks are completed efficiently, operational issues are communicated to the appropriate teams, and all required documentation is completed before drivers leave pickup or delivery locations. You will work closely with U.S. Operations Leads to coordinate local executions, prioritize assignments, and handle ad-hoc operational needs throughout the shift. Because local volume may fluctuate, you should also be comfortable supporting OTR tracking and other transportation operations tasks when there are no immediate local executions.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor local drivers throughout the shift, coordinate assignments, and keep drivers moving efficiently based on availability, location, HOS, equipment, and operational priorities.

• Track driver locations, load progress, ETAs, pickups, deliveries, and other milestones while keeping TMS, Google Sheets, and tracking platforms accurate and up to date.

• Work closely with U.S. Operations Leads to coordinate local executions, ad-hoc tasks, and operational issues involving trucks, trailers, equipment, loads, or service concerns.

• Ensure required paperwork, receiver signatures, status updates, and timestamps are completed, and proactively follow up or escalate delays, missing information, or time-sensitive issues.

• Support OTR tracking when local activity is limited and maintain organized documentation and complete shift handoffs for pending drivers, loads, and operational issues.



What Success Looks Like

• Local drivers stay productive, receive clear next assignments, and avoid unnecessary downtime.

• Daily local tasks are scheduled, prioritized, and completed efficiently.

• Truck, trailer, paperwork, and service issues are identified early and communicated to the appropriate team.

• Load data, tracking platforms, and delivery paperwork remain accurate, complete, and up to date.

• OTR support and shift handoffs are handled effectively when local activity is limited.



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in logistics, trucking, dispatch, transportation tracking, or fleet operations preferred

• Understanding of local fleet coordination, dispatch operations, load tracking, and Hours of Service

• Familiarity with U.S. geography and U.S. trucking operations is a plus

• Able to coordinate several drivers and operational tasks simultaneously without losing accuracy

• Strong sense of urgency and ability to prioritize assignments based on operational needs

• Proactive in keeping drivers moving rather than waiting for issues or assignments to be brought up

• Understands the importance of obtaining complete and properly signed transportation documentation

• Communicates clearly and professionally through Zoom, verbal communication, chat, and

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Strong attention to detail and sound judgment when operational issues arise

• Comfortable working in a high-volume, fast-moving transportation environment

• Flexible and willing to support both local and OTR operations depending on daily workload

• Follows SOPs and instructions consistently

• Works collaboratively with the team and is receptive to feedback and coaching



Why Join AJG Transport?

• Permanent remote opportunity

• Structured systems and clear expectations

• Hands on leadership and direct feedback

• Defined KPIs and measurable growth

• Opportunity to grow within a scaling freight brokerage

• Performance recognition and advancement potential



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full Time Role

• Available shift: Tuesday - Sunday 7 AM - 5 PM CDT

• Time tracking software used for accountability and performance support

• Shifts may adjust based on operational demand



If you thrive in fast-moving transportation operations, can keep drivers productive throughout the day, and are comfortable switching between local execution and OTR support based on operational needs, we want to hear from you.

title: Sales Representative
description:
Join a fast-growing US online home goods retailer and enjoy the learning and opportunities that you have while working with us.



We strive to provide 5-star service & shopping assistance to all of our clients, and all of our team is accountable for fulfilling this.



We are looking for a Sales Representative who can assist prospective buyers and close online ecommerce sales.



We're only looking for full-time, long-term, ongoing cooperation.



Work schedules available:

8 AM to 4 PM US EST

4 PM to 12 AM US EST



Your work week will be 5 days per week, with 2 days off per week. Days off will be selected with your manager. We will try to accommodate your preferences for which days you like, based on availability.



This role starts ASAP.



Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up emails, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person that contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

After each interaction with a prospect/customer, writes notes & comments in our CRM (Asana)

Communicate efficiently and build rapport with potential customers

Assists prospects in their shopping journey and helps make the purchase decision

Ensures that all prospects’ questions and objections are addressed

Leads every interaction to a close sale, which means an order is placed on our online store

Prepares custom quotes, price matches competitors if necessary, and offers custom discounts. This requires calculating margins & ensuring profitability.

Answering questions about the products we offer, including technical questions. Learns the specifications, features and benefits of our bestsellers. Over time, becomes an expert in the industry.

If not able to answer product-specific questions, conducts research in the materials provided by the supplier, or reaches out to the supplier to get the information

Confirms stock availability and lead times when offering products to prospects

Documents standard procedures and best practices in a written form, so that other tea ---------- mbers can learn from them



Requirements:

At least 2 years of experience in sales on the phone

Experience must include both inbound and outbound sales

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Experience in Customer Service on the phone is a nice to have

Experience in the e-commerce (online shopping) industry is nice to have

Home improvement, construction, and gas plumbing industry experience is a plus

Outgoing, friendly, and lively

Can-do mindset, with a sense of ownership, pride in your performance, and its impact on the company’s success

Long-term commitment - treat this as your career



What we can offer:

Sales commission: 8% of gross profit from all orders closed. Gross profit means the sale amount minus the product and shipping costs. Paid monthly. No upper limit. Monthly commission payouts range between $1,200 (the guaranteed minimum) and as high as $3,000 (for the top performer). The average monthly payout is $1,465 (average from the last 2 years).

$1,200/month minimum guaranteed pay

15 days paid days off per year (also convertible to min. guaranteed commission)

Paid training on all aspects of the role

Opportunities for professional development

Friendly atmosphere

Online Interview process

Fully remote position

title: Lead Graphic Designer

You should be highly disciplined in design principles, capable of establishing clear visual standards, and confident guiding designers, freelancers, and other creative contributors.

Create, develop, and maintain comprehensive brand guidelines and visual standards.

Translate business and marketing objectives into strong, consistent creative concepts.

Identify inconsistencies or weaknesses in creative work and provide clear recommendations for improvement.

Develop strong base designs and scalable creative systems that can be efficiently adapted across campaigns and platforms.



Team and Creative Management

Manage, guide, and provide creative direction to designers, freelancers, and other creative contributors.

Assign and prioritize design projects based on business needs, deadlines, and expected impact.

Review creative work and provide specific, constructive, and actionable feedback.

Set clear expectations for quality, turnaround time, file organization, and brand consistency.

Help team members improve their design judgment, technical execution, and use of creative tools.

Monitor project progress and address quality or productivity issues before they affect deadlines.

Collaborate with marketing leadership and other departments to keep creative projects aligned with company priorities.



Design Production

Personally create high-priority marketing assets, key campaign concepts, templates, and foundational designs.

Produce digital and print materials such as:

Website and landing-page graphics

 marketing visuals

Social media content and advertisements

Brochures, flyers, posters, catalogs, and product inserts

Product packaging and labels

Product infographics and e-commerce listing images

Amazon storefront and A+ Content

Campaign concepts and promotional materials

Prepare accurate, production-ready files for digital and print use.

Review dielines, proofs, dimensions, colors, bleeds, and other production specifications.



Workflow, AI, and Production Efficiency

Introduce efficient design workflows that improve both creative quality and production speed.

Use AI-assisted design tools, automation, templates, and reusable creative systems where appropriate.

Evaluate productivity based on the quality, usefulness, and timeliness of completed output—not hours worked alone.

Stay current with emerging AI capabilities, design technologies, and creative-production practices.

Maintain quality control and original creative judgment when using AI-generated or AI-assisted materials.



Requirements



Leadership Experience

At least 5 years of professional graphic design experience, preferably supporting marketing, e-commerce, retail, or consumer-product brands.

Previous experience as a Lead Designer, Senior Designer with leadership responsibilities, Design Manager, Art Director, or similar position.

Demonstrated experience managing designers, freelancers, or creative projects.

Ability to evaluate creative work, explain design decisions, and coach others toward better output.

Strong command of typography, layout, composition, color theory, hierarchy, spacing, and visual storytelling.

Strong understanding of print-production requirements, including dielines, bleeds, color modes, resolution, and file preparation.

Experience with collaborative tools such as Figma or Canva is an advantage.

Experience creating Amazon listing images or A+ Content is preferred but not required.

Familiarity with AI-assisted creative tools and workflows is strongly preferred.



What We’re Looking For

A disciplined designer who consistently applies fundamental design principles.

A creative leader who can establish direction rather than wait for highly detailed instructions.

A hands-on manager who can both produce excellent work and improve the work of others.

Someone who understands the difference between completing a task and creating an effective marketing asset.

A professional who values output quality, speed, accuracy, and business impact.

Someone comfortable adopting AI and new technology to strengthen—not replace—creative judgment.

A clear communicator who can give and receive direct, constructive feedback.

A proactive problem-solver who identifies inefficiencies and recommends practical improvements.

title: Direct-Response Video Editor for Health Brand | Long-term, $1000-1300 monthly
description:
Please read the whole post, before you apply.



We're Dreaver. We're a lifestyle brand, that currently sells treadmills and other fitness equipment for the home, direct to people who want to move more without a gym membership or the pressure from booking a class. We run ads in the Netherlands, Denmark and Sweden — more markets can follow. Creative is the lever that moves the needle for us, and we are looking for a loyal editor to own our video output long-term.



This is direct-response editing, not video production. If your scope is weddings, corporate or long-form YouTube, we won't be a good client for you.



What you'd be doing

Cutting UGC, founder footage and mash-ups into Meta ads, 9:16 and 4:5. Hook variants tested against each other. Editing to AI voiceover with clean sync and pacing. Occasionally an AI b-roll or AI UGC shot from Higgsfield, made to not look like AI. Captions, pattern interrupts, retention pacing, end cards. Re-cutting winners into new angles instead of starting from zero.



Multiple markets | NL, DK, SE, ...

Native translators on the team handle scripting and copy per market, you don't need to write or speak Danish or Swedish. But editing is a different skill from translating. You need enough sense of those languages to catch when a caption runs too long, a hook doesn't land the same way it does in English, or a cut point falls wrong against the sentence. If you can only judge pacing and hooks in English, this role isn't for you. A creative sense for scripting and concepting, someone who can push back on a script or suggest a better opening, is a big plus.



How we work

This is how we work:

Ownership matters, you don't wait for a brief to fix what you can already see.

Speed. We'd rather test fast than think long. We learn by doing and improve as we go.

Proactive. You don't wait around. You spot opportunities, flag problems, and act.

Fix > perfect. See something that could be better? Fix it. Perfection isn't the requirement, progress is.



Tools

Premiere Pro or CapCut, non-negotiable. Comfortable with Higgsfield and ElevenLabs for the occasional AI shot and voice-overs. We're not hiring an AI specialist, just someone who won't freeze the first time AI footage lands in their timeline. When working together, we pay for all AI subscriptions, on our accounts.



What we offer

- Full-time

- $
per month, depending on level

- Perform well and you grow with us. More scope, better pay.

- Work when you work best. No fixed hours, just deadlines and a few hours overlap with Amsterdam CET

- Long-term. We want someone for years, not a project



How to apply

 
 with the subject line in exactly this format:

[Your name] | [years editing DR ads] | [months using Higgsfield] | [length in seconds of the AI video you're sending]

Example: Anna Nowak | 3 | 7 | 24



Then in the body, exactly these six lines and nothing else. No cover letter, no CV, no attachments — links only.



1. Best UGC or founder ad you've edited:

2. What it sold and how it performed:

3. Best AI video (or clip) you've made

4. Best moment in the ad from line 1 — timestamp (mm:ss) and why, max 2 sentences:

5. Loom link (90 seconds max, camera on) --> open one of the two videos on your screen and talk us through one editing decision, and why. Not a pitch, not your CV. We want to hear how you think.



You will be skipped for: wrong subject format, a CV instead of links, attachments, weddings or corporate work, "I am hardworking and a fast learner," or anything that could have been sent to any company. 



We want to hear from you. Really see you and build that true connection.

title: Senior Salesforce / Litify Developer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Developer to take ownership of a significant Salesforce/Litify implementation and integration project for our company.



This is not a basic Salesforce administrator position. We need someone who is comfortable designing solutions, migrating and cleaning large amounts of existing data, building Salesforce automations, working with APIs, and integrating third-party platforms.



The Project



Our company currently has a significant amount of business and client/lead data stored in spreadsheets. We need to migrate this information into Salesforce/Litify and build a reliable Salesforce environment that our team can use going forward.



A major part of the project will also be integrating our calling platform, PhoneBurner, with Salesforce/Litify so that our team can efficiently make calls while keeping contact information, call activity, statuses, notes, and other relevant information synchronized.



You will help us design the system correctly rather than simply copying our existing spreadsheets into Salesforce.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Reviewing our existing spreadsheets and understanding our current data structure and workflows

* Designing the appropriate Salesforce/Litify data architecture

* Mapping spreadsheet fields to Salesforce/Litify objects and fields

* Cleaning, standardizing, deduplicating, and preparing data for migration

* Importing and validating our existing data

* Configuring Salesforce/Litify objects, fields, permissions, layouts, and workflows

* Building Salesforce Flows and other automations

* Developing custom Salesforce functionality when required using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, etc.

* Integrating PhoneBurner with Salesforce/Litify

* Working with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and other integration technologies

* Ensuring call activity and relevant PhoneBurner data are properly captured inside Salesforce/Litify

* Troubleshooting synchronization and integration issues

* Creating appropriate sandbox/testing environments and testing changes before production deployment

* Documenting the system and customizations you build

* Training our team on the finished system

* Providing ongoing Salesforce/Litify development and support after implementation



Required Experience



We are specifically looking for someone with strong experience in:



* Salesforce development and administration

* Salesforce data migrations

* Large CSV/Excel/spreadsheet data imports

* Data mapping and data cleanup

* Salesforce Flow

* Apex

* SOQL

* Lightning / Lightning Web Components

* Salesforce REST APIs

* OAuth

* Webhooks and third-party API integrations

* Git/version control and proper deployment practices

* Building and maintaining production Salesforce environments



Strongly Preferred



Experience with any of the following will be a major advantage:



* Litify

* PhoneBurner

* Salesforce telephony/dialer integrations

* Legal industry CRM systems

* Salesforce managed packages

* High-volume lead/contact management

* Building custom Salesforce integrations



Direct Litify experience is highly preferred.



What Success Looks Like



The goal is to create a Salesforce/Litify environment that becomes the central system for our business.



Our existing spreadsheet data should be accurately migrated and organized, duplicate and inconsistent records should be addressed, and our team should be able to work primarily inside Salesforce/Litify rather than maintaining separate spreadsheets.



PhoneBurner should also work smoothly with the system so our team can efficiently call leads/contacts while keeping Salesforce/Litify records and call activity up to date.



Schedule



Full-time, approximately 40 hours per week, 



Exceptional candidates with significant Litify, Salesforce integration, and API development experience may be considered above this range.



This will initially be a major implementation project, with the opportunity for a long-term role maintaining and improving our Salesforce/Litify environment.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. How many years have you worked with Salesforce?

2. Have you worked with Litify? If yes, please describe the project.

3. Have you completed a large Salesforce data migration? Approximately how many records were involved?

4. Describe a third-party API integration you personally built for Salesforce.

5. Have you worked with PhoneBurner or another Salesforce dialer/telephony platform?

6. What Salesforce certifications do you currently hold?

title: Paid Media Creative Specialist (PH)
description:
PH - Paid Media Creative Specialist



We're looking for a PH - Marketing Creative Specialist to own the creative outcomes for paid social campaigns — concepts, iterations, and final static and video deliverables — directly driving the metrics (CTR, hook rate, thumb-stop/hold rate, cost per result) that determine campaign performance, while also making ads that are beautiful and delight our clients.



You'll also be stepping into building and owning AI-augmented creative workflows — using AI as leverage to increase the volume and quality of what you ship, without letting it replace your own trend instincts and creative judgment.



We’re looking for a creative who loves Meta - who lives and breathes Instagram. And who is obsessed with what makes content convert - both organically and in paid ads. You’ll get the autonomy and creative freedom to make amazing designs - and the responsibility for how those perform, and more importantly, using how they perform to improve what we make next. Done well, you’ll help us build creative capability that not just delights our clients, but delivers on ROI and growth.



Our objectives for the role

- Ship creatives that delight our practices: creatives that highlight what’s best about their practices, results, and branding – and that they’re so excited about that they regularly ask us if they can post our ads as organic content on their feeds, too.

- Own creative performance (CTR, hook rate, thumb-stop/hold rate, cost per result) across your designs – and turn patterns of performance into meaningful insights and repeatable elements or frameworks that get actioned in feedback loops into your work and the broader team.

- Spot trends and micro-trends and translate them into on-brand, executable static and video creatives – that appeal to the right audiences and pain points for a given campaign.

- Demonstrate command of production tools, specs, file setup, and platform requirements across Meta placements, and become a go-to resource on specs and complex production issues (compression, accessibility, delivery).

- Contribute to AI-driven creative workflows and frameworks — for concepting, production, or testing — that get adopted across the broader creative team.

- Scale a creative process or workflow into standard team practice, and act as a subject-matter expert whose creative-performance patterns guide the rest of the team.



We're looking for:

- Top Tier Aesthetic Taste — you know the exact layouts, fonts, music, and styling that will make creative pop. You can design for multiple aesthetics and never ship a boring or basic creative.

- Creative ownership and execution — you can spot a trend, shape the concept, write the direction, and personally ship the work across both static and video, within provided frameworks, not just execute someone else's brief. This includes writing the copy and executing the design work, on-brand, and owning its performance in the ad platforms.

- Performance fluency — you're fluent in performance creative and think in terms of the metrics that matter: CTR, hook rate, cost per result, and ultimately, ROI.

- Turn Patterns into Systems — you see the hook that performs in every video ad you ship as a repeatable element you should mix into every new video we script, and that one red button that always makes a graphic’s cost per lead lower as your ace in your back pocket for accounts whose creative just doesn’t hit. And you’re ready to take this skill further into templates that de-risk creative performance, using insights from across a portfolio of brands running similar ads.

- Production mastery — deep command of specs, file setup,editing/creating tools (including AI augmentation), and platform requirements, with the ability to independently resolve production issues that stump others.

- Trend fluency — you already think like a trend-setter; spotting what's next is a skill you own, not something you outsource to an algorithm.

- Productive use of AI — you build and own AI-augmented workflows, using AI as leverage rather than a crutch or a replacement for your judgment. Ads and creatives that are obviously AI give you the ick - and you would never give us a final product that looks like Claude, or Chat, or some other AI tool’s basic output - even though you probably did use them to help you execute it.



Why Join us?

- Above all, we're in this to empower small business owners to own and grow their businesses. If you succeed, MedSpas will remain the opportunity for independent owner-operators instead of being dominated by a small number of large chains. If that speaks to you, speak to us.

- This role is built for a creative who wants real ownership — not just execution against someone else's brief, but the ability to spot a trend, shape the concept, write the direction, and personally ship the work, across both static and video.

- It's a high-autonomy, high-trust role with a clear growth path toward creative leadership, working at the frontier of AI-augmented creative production without being replaced by it.

- Competitive salary
